            "text": "I am building a full-stack web app called \"ParkSmart\" in GitHub Codespaces in under 2.5 hours. Build it step by step, and make sure each step compiles and runs before moving on.\r\n\r\nENVIRONMENT: JDK 25 and Maven 3.9 are installed. Use <java.version>21</java.version> in pom.xml. Spring Boot 3.5.x. Do NOT use Lombok — write plain getters/setters/constructors. Run with: mvn spring-boot:run on port 8080.\r\n\r\nTECH STACK:\r\n- Backend: Spring Web, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Validation, jjwt (0.12.x) for JWT, BCrypt passwords.\r\n- Database: SQLite (org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc + org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-community-dialects, SQLiteDialect), file ./parksmart.db, ddl-auto=update, hikari maximum-pool-size=1. Add a commented MySQL config in application.properties.\r\n- Frontend: plain HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (fetch API) in src/main/resources/static. No frameworks.\r\n- Tests: JUnit 5 + MockMvc (@SpringBootTest), tests use a separate SQLite file.\r\n\r\nPROBLEM: A multi-level city-centre parking garage attendant must check cars in/out and charge the correct fee. It must work for ANY garage (configurable, not hardcoded).\r\n\r\nBUSINESS RULES (must be exact):\r\n1. Rates configurable per garage: firstHourRate, extraHourRate (cheaper), dailyCap. Use BigDecimal for money.\r\n2. Duration rounds UP to whole hours (61 min = 2 h). Minimum 1 hour.\r\n3. Fee = fullDays * dailyCap + min(dailyCap, firstHourRate + (remainingHours-1) * extraHourRate) for the remainder if > 0. Never more than dailyCap per 24h. Implement as a pure FeeCalculator class with JUnit tests: 1 min, 59 min, 60 min, 61 min, 5 h, cap hit within a day, exactly 24 h, 25 h, 50 h.\r\n4. Spot types: COMPACT, STANDARD, EV. Vehicle types: COMPACT, STANDARD, EV. EV vehicle MUST get an EV spot. COMPACT car prefers COMPACT spot, else STANDARD. STANDARD car uses STANDARD only.\r\n5. No double parking: a spot can hold only one active session, and a plate only one active session per garage. Enforce in a @Transactional service AND at DB level: parking_session has nullable UNIQUE columns active_spot_id and active_plate_key (garageId:plate), set on check-in, set to NULL on check-out. Catch DataIntegrityViolationException -> 409 Conflict.\r\n6. Normalize plates (uppercase, remove spaces and dashes).\r\n\r\nENTITIES:\r\n- User(id, name, email unique, passwordHash, createdAt)\r\n- Garage(id, name, address, firstHourRate, extraHourRate, dailyCap, createdAt)\r\n- Spot(id, garage, level, code, type; unique(garage_id, code))\r\n- ParkingSession(id, garage, spot, plate, vehicleType, checkedInAt, checkedOutAt nullable, hoursBilled, fee, attendant, activeSpotId unique nullable, activePlateKey unique nullable); indexes on plate and checkedInAt.\r\n- DataSeeder (CommandLineRunner): if DB empty, create demo garage \"City Centre Garage\" (rates 50 / 30 / cap 300) with 3 levels and mixed spot types, and demo user admin@parksmart.com / admin123.\r\n\r\nREST API (JSON; JWT required except /api/auth/** and static pages):\r\nPOST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login (returns token), GET /api/auth/me\r\nGET /api/garages, POST /api/garages, GET /api/garages/{id}, PUT /api/garages/{id}\r\nGET /api/garages/{id}/spots, POST /api/garages/{id}/spots (bulk create)\r\nGET /api/garages/{id}/availability?type=EV -> free counts per type and level + free spot list\r\nPOST /api/garages/{id}/checkin {plate, vehicleType, spotId optional}\r\nPOST /api/garages/{id}/checkout {plate} -> duration minutes, hours billed, fee breakdown\r\nGET /api/garages/{id}/quote?plate= -> fee if the car left now\r\nGET /api/garages/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\r\nGET /api/garages/{id}/sessions?q=&status=ACTIVE|COMPLETED&from=&to=&page=0&size=20&sort=checkedInAt,desc -> Pageable + Specification; return {content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages}\r\nUse DTOs, @Valid, and @RestControllerAdvice returning {error:{code,message}} with 400/401/404/409.\r\n\r\nPACKAGES (com.parksmart): config (SecurityConfig, JwtFilter, JwtUtil), controller, service (FeeCalculator, ParkingService, AuthService), repository, entity, dto, exception, seed.\r\n\r\nFRONTEND (static):\r\n- index.html = one-page LANDING: what ParkSmart is, key features, target audience, how it helps, \"Coming next\" with 3 features (plate-recognition camera, online pre-booking, EV charging billing). Login/Register buttons.\r\n- login.html, register.html (store JWT in localStorage).\r\n- dashboard.html: garage selector; availability cards (Compact/Standard/EV free counts + big \"EV spot free now?\" YES/NO badge); check-in form; check-out form with fee breakdown; search car by plate; sessions log table with pagination, sortable headers, status and date filters; logout.\r\n- css/style.css (clean, responsive), js/api.js (fetch wrapper with Bearer token, redirect on 401), js/dashboard.js.\r\n- SecurityConfig must permit /, /*.html, /css/**, /js/**, /api/auth/**.\r\n\r\nDOCS:\r\n- README.md: prerequisites, run in Codespaces (port 8080), run tests, reset DB, switch to MySQL, debugging tips, full API endpoint table with sample curl.\r\n- REASONING.md: assumptions, fee formula with examples, design decisions, double-parking prevention, how I tested and bugs I fixed.\r\n- .gitignore (target/, *.db).\r\n\r\nStart by: 1) showing the plan and folder tree, 2) pom.xml and application.properties, 3) FeeCalculator + tests (run mvn test), then entities, auth, check-in/out, availability, search/pagination, frontend, docs. After each step run/verify it and tell me the command.",
            "kind": "text"
          }

          "edits": [

              {
                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.math.RoundingMode;\n\npublic final class FeeCalculator {\n    private FeeCalculator() {\n    }\n\n    public static Breakdown calculate(long durationMinutes, BigDecimal firstHourRate,\n                                      BigDecimal extraHourRate, BigDecimal dailyCap) {\n        long hours = Math.max(1, (durationMinutes + 59) / 60);\n        long fullDays = hours / 24;\n        long remainingHours = hours % 24;\n        BigDecimal remainder = BigDecimal.ZERO;\n        if (remainingHours > 0) {\n            remainder = firstHourRate.add(extraHourRate.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(remainingHours - 1L)))\n                    .min(dailyCap);\n        }\n        BigDecimal total = dailyCap.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(fullDays)).add(remainder);\n        return new Breakdown(durationMinutes, hours, fullDays, remainingHours, remainder,\n                total.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));\n    }\n\n    public record Breakdown(long durationMinutes, long hoursBilled, long fullDays,\n                            long remainingHours, BigDecimal remainderFee, BigDecimal totalFee) {\n    }\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\n\nimport org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;\n\nclass FeeCalculatorTest {\n    private static final BigDecimal FIRST = new BigDecimal(\"50\");\n    private static final BigDecimal EXTRA = new BigDecimal(\"30\");\n    private static final BigDecimal CAP = new BigDecimal(\"300\");\n\n    @Test\n    void calculatesRequiredDurations() {\n        assertFee(1, 50, 1, 0, 1);\n        assertFee(59, 50, 1, 0, 1);\n        assertFee(60, 50, 1, 0, 1);\n        assertFee(61, 80, 2, 0, 2);\n        assertFee(300, 170, 5, 0, 5);\n        assertFee(720, 300, 12, 0, 12);\n        assertFee(1440, 300, 1, 0, 24);\n        assertFee(1500, 350, 1, 1, 25);\n        assertFee(3000, 650, 2, 2, 50);\n    }\n\n    private void assertFee(long minutes, int expectedFee, int expectedHours,\n                           int expectedFullDays, int expectedReportedHours) {\n        FeeCalculator.Breakdown result = FeeCalculator.calculate(minutes, FIRST, EXTRA, CAP);\n        assertEquals(expectedHours, result.hoursBilled());\n        assertEquals(expectedFullDays, result.fullDays());\n        assertEquals(expectedReportedHours, result.fullDays() * 24 + result.remainingHours());\n        assertEquals(new BigDecimal(expectedFee).setScale(2), result.totalFee());\n    }\n}",
                "range": {

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\n\nimport org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;\n\nclass FeeCalculatorTest {\n    private static final BigDecimal FIRST = new BigDecimal(\"50\");\n    private static final BigDecimal EXTRA = new BigDecimal(\"30\");\n    private static final BigDecimal CAP = new BigDecimal(\"300\");\n\n    @Test\n    void calculatesRequiredDurations() {\n        assertFee(1, 50, 1, 0, 1);\n        assertFee(59, 50, 1, 0, 1);\n        assertFee(60, 50, 1, 0, 1);\n        assertFee(61, 80, 2, 0, 2);\n        assertFee(300, 170, 5, 0, 5);\n        assertFee(720, 300, 12, 0, 12);\n        assertFee(1440, 300, 24, 1, 24);\n        assertFee(1500, 350, 25, 1, 25);\n        assertFee(3000, 680, 50, 2, 50);\n    }\n\n    private void assertFee(long minutes, int expectedFee, int expectedHours,\n                           int expectedFullDays, int expectedReportedHours) {\n        FeeCalculator.Breakdown result = FeeCalculator.calculate(minutes, FIRST, EXTRA, CAP);\n        assertEquals(expectedHours, result.hoursBilled());\n        assertEquals(expectedFullDays, result.fullDays());\n        assertEquals(expectedReportedHours, result.fullDays() * 24 + result.remainingHours());\n        assertEquals(new BigDecimal(expectedFee).setScale(2), result.totalFee());\n    }\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\n\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport jakarta.persistence.*;\n\n@Entity @Table(name = \"app_user\")\npublic class User {\n    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id;\n    private String name;\n    @Column(nullable = false, unique = true) private String email;\n    @Column(nullable = false) private String passwordHash;\n    @Column(nullable = false) private Instant createdAt = Instant.now();\n    public User() {}\n    public User(String name, String email, String passwordHash) { this.name=name; this.email=email; this.passwordHash=passwordHash; }\n    public Long getId(){return id;} public String getName(){return name;} public void setName(String v){name=v;}\n    public String getEmail(){return email;} public void setEmail(String v){email=v;} public String getPasswordHash(){return passwordHash;} public void setPasswordHash(String v){passwordHash=v;}\n    public Instant getCreatedAt(){return createdAt;} public void setCreatedAt(Instant v){createdAt=v;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport jakarta.persistence.*;\n\n@Entity @Table(name=\"garage\")\npublic class Garage {\n    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private String name; private String address;\n    @Column(nullable=false, precision=12, scale=2) private BigDecimal firstHourRate;\n    @Column(nullable=false, precision=12, scale=2) private BigDecimal extraHourRate;\n    @Column(nullable=false, precision=12, scale=2) private BigDecimal dailyCap;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private Instant createdAt=Instant.now();\n    public Garage() {} public Garage(String name,String address,BigDecimal first,BigDecimal extra,BigDecimal cap){this.name=name;this.address=address;firstHourRate=first;extraHourRate=extra;dailyCap=cap;}\n    public Long getId(){return id;} public String getName(){return name;} public void setName(String v){name=v;} public String getAddress(){return address;} public void setAddress(String v){address=v;}\n    public BigDecimal getFirstHourRate(){return firstHourRate;} public void setFirstHourRate(BigDecimal v){firstHourRate=v;} public BigDecimal getExtraHourRate(){return extraHourRate;} public void setExtraHourRate(BigDecimal v){extraHourRate=v;} public BigDecimal getDailyCap(){return dailyCap;} public void setDailyCap(BigDecimal v){dailyCap=v;} public Instant getCreatedAt(){return createdAt;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\n\nimport jakarta.persistence.*;\n\n@Entity @Table(name=\"spot\", uniqueConstraints=@UniqueConstraint(columnNames={\"garage_id\",\"code\"}))\npublic class Spot {\n    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false, fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Garage garage;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private int level; @Column(nullable=false) private String code;\n    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) @Column(nullable=false) private SpotType type;\n    public Spot() {} public Spot(Garage garage,int level,String code,SpotType type){this.garage=garage;this.level=level;this.code=code;this.type=type;}\n    public Long getId(){return id;} public Garage getGarage(){return garage;} public void setGarage(Garage v){garage=v;} public int getLevel(){return level;} public void setLevel(int v){level=v;} public String getCode(){return code;} public void setCode(String v){code=v;} public SpotType getType(){return type;} public void setType(SpotType v){type=v;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import java.time.Instant;\nimport jakarta.persistence.*;\n\n@Entity @Table(name=\"parking_session\", indexes={@Index(name=\"idx_session_plate\",columnList=\"plate\"),@Index(name=\"idx_session_checked_in\",columnList=\"checkedInAt\")}, uniqueConstraints={@UniqueConstraint(columnNames=\"activeSpotId\"),@UniqueConstraint(columnNames=\"activePlateKey\")})\npublic class ParkingSession {\n    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Garage garage;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Spot spot;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private String plate; @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) @Column(nullable=false) private VehicleType vehicleType;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private Instant checkedInAt; private Instant checkedOutAt; private Long hoursBilled; @Column(precision=12,scale=2) private BigDecimal fee;\n    @ManyToOne(fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private User attendant;\n    @Column(unique=true) private Long activeSpotId; @Column(unique=true) private String activePlateKey;\n    public ParkingSession() {}\n    public Long getId(){return id;} public Garage getGarage(){return garage;} public void setGarage(Garage v){garage=v;} public Spot getSpot(){return spot;} public void setSpot(Spot v){spot=v;} public String getPlate(){return plate;} public void setPlate(String v){plate=v;} public VehicleType getVehicleType(){return vehicleType;} public void setVehicleType(VehicleType v){vehicleType=v;} public Instant getCheckedInAt(){return checkedInAt;} public void setCheckedInAt(Instant v){checkedInAt=v;} public Instant getCheckedOutAt(){return checkedOutAt;} public void setCheckedOutAt(Instant v){checkedOutAt=v;} public Long getHoursBilled(){return hoursBilled;} public void setHoursBilled(Long v){hoursBilled=v;} public BigDecimal getFee(){return fee;} public void setFee(BigDecimal v){fee=v;} public User getAttendant(){return attendant;} public void setAttendant(User v){attendant=v;} public Long getActiveSpotId(){return activeSpotId;} public void setActiveSpotId(Long v){activeSpotId=v;} public String getActivePlateKey(){return activePlateKey;} public void setActivePlateKey(String v){activePlateKey=v;}\n}",

          "edits": [

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import java.time.Instant;\nimport jakarta.persistence.*;\n\n@Entity @Table(name=\"parking_session\", indexes={@Index(name=\"idx_session_plate\",columnList=\"plate\"),@Index(name=\"idx_session_checked_in\",columnList=\"checked_in_at\")}, uniqueConstraints={@UniqueConstraint(columnNames=\"active_spot_id\"),@UniqueConstraint(columnNames=\"active_plate_key\")})\npublic class ParkingSession {\n    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Garage garage;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Spot spot;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private String plate; @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) @Column(nullable=false) private VehicleType vehicleType;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private Instant checkedInAt; private Instant checkedOutAt; private Long hoursBilled; @Column(precision=12,scale=2) private BigDecimal fee;\n    @ManyToOne(fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private User attendant;\n    @Column(name=\"active_spot_id\", unique=true) private Long activeSpotId; @Column(name=\"active_plate_key\", unique=true) private String activePlateKey;\n    public ParkingSession() {}\n    public Long getId(){return id;} public Garage getGarage(){return garage;} public void setGarage(Garage v){garage=v;} public Spot getSpot(){return spot;} public void setSpot(Spot v){spot=v;} public String getPlate(){return plate;} public void setPlate(String v){plate=v;} public VehicleType getVehicleType(){return vehicleType;} public void setVehicleType(VehicleType v){vehicleType=v;} public Instant getCheckedInAt(){return checkedInAt;} public void setCheckedInAt(Instant v){checkedInAt=v;} public Instant getCheckedOutAt(){return checkedOutAt;} public void setCheckedOutAt(Instant v){checkedOutAt=v;} public Long getHoursBilled(){return hoursBilled;} public void setHoursBilled(Long v){hoursBilled=v;} public BigDecimal getFee(){return fee;} public void setFee(BigDecimal v){fee=v;} public User getAttendant(){return attendant;} public void setAttendant(User v){attendant=v;} public Long getActiveSpotId(){return activeSpotId;} public void setActiveSpotId(Long v){activeSpotId=v;} public String getActivePlateKey(){return activePlateKey;} public void setActivePlateKey(String v){activePlateKey=v;}\n}",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 18,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }
            ],

                "text": "package com.parksmart.exception;\nimport java.util.Map; import org.springframework.http.*; import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;\n@RestControllerAdvice public class GlobalExceptionHandler {\n    @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class) ResponseEntity<?> api(ApiException e){return ResponseEntity.status(e.getStatus()).body(Map.of(\"error\",Map.of(\"code\",e.getCode(),\"message\",e.getMessage())));}\n    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class) ResponseEntity<?> validation(MethodArgumentNotValidException e){return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of(\"error\",Map.of(\"code\",\"VALIDATION_ERROR\",\"message\",e.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream().findFirst().map(x->x.getField()+\" is invalid\").orElse(\"Invalid request\"))));}\n    @ExceptionHandler(DataIntegrityViolationException.class) ResponseEntity<?> conflict(DataIntegrityViolationException e){return ResponseEntity.status(409).body(Map.of(\"error\",Map.of(\"code\",\"CONFLICT\",\"message\",\"Parking spot or plate is already active\")));}\n    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class) ResponseEntity<?> other(Exception e){return ResponseEntity.status(500).body(Map.of(\"error\",Map.of(\"code\",\"INTERNAL_ERROR\",\"message\",\"Unexpected server error\")));}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.config;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets; import java.util.Date; import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value; import org.springframework.stereotype.Component; import io.jsonwebtoken.*; import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys; import javax.crypto.SecretKey;\n@Component public class JwtUtil {\n    private final SecretKey key; private final long expiration;\n    public JwtUtil(@Value(\"${parksmart.jwt.secret}\") String secret,@Value(\"${parksmart.jwt.expiration-ms}\") long expiration){key=Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));this.expiration=expiration;}\n    public String generate(String email){Date now=new Date();return Jwts.builder().subject(email).issuedAt(now).expiration(new Date(now.getTime()+expiration)).signWith(key).compact();}\n    public String subject(String token){return Jwts.parser().verifyWith(key).build().parseSignedClaims(token).getPayload().getSubject();}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.config;\nimport java.io.IOException; import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken; import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder; import org.springframework.stereotype.Component; import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter; import jakarta.servlet.*; import jakarta.servlet.http.*;\n@Component public class JwtFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter { private final JwtUtil jwt; public JwtFilter(JwtUtil jwt){this.jwt=jwt;} protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest req,HttpServletResponse res,FilterChain chain)throws ServletException,IOException{String h=req.getHeader(\"Authorization\");if(h!=null&&h.startsWith(\"Bearer \"))try{String sub=jwt.subject(h.substring(7));SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(sub,null,java.util.List.of()));}catch(Exception ignored){}chain.doFilter(req,res);} }",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.config;\nimport org.springframework.context.annotation.*; import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity; import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy; import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder; import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder; import org.springframework.security.web.*; import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;\n@Configuration public class SecurityConfig { @Bean PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder(){return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();} @Bean SecurityFilterChain security(HttpSecurity http,JwtFilter filter)throws Exception{return http.csrf(c->c.disable()).cors(c->c.disable()).sessionManagement(s->s.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS)).authorizeHttpRequests(a->a.requestMatchers(\"/\",\"/*.html\",\"/css/**\",\"/js/**\",\"/api/auth/**\").permitAll().anyRequest().authenticated()).addFilterBefore(filter,UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class).build();} }",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import com.parksmart.config.JwtUtil; import com.parksmart.dto.AuthDtos; import com.parksmart.entity.User; import com.parksmart.exception.ApiException; import com.parksmart.repository.UserRepository; import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;\n@Service public class AuthService { private final UserRepository users; private final PasswordEncoder encoder; private final JwtUtil jwt; public AuthService(UserRepository u,PasswordEncoder e,JwtUtil j){users=u;encoder=e;jwt=j;}\n public User register(AuthDtos.Register r){if(users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(r.email).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"EMAIL_EXISTS\",\"Email already registered\");return users.save(new User(r.name,r.email.toLowerCase(),encoder.encode(r.password)));}\n public String login(AuthDtos.Login r){User u=users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(r.email).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,\"INVALID_CREDENTIALS\",\"Invalid email or password\"));if(!encoder.matches(r.password,u.getPasswordHash()))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,\"INVALID_CREDENTIALS\",\"Invalid email or password\");return jwt.generate(u.getEmail());}\n public User current(String email){return users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,\"UNAUTHORIZED\",\"User not found\"));}}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.controller;\nimport java.util.Map; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.AuthDtos; import com.parksmart.service.AuthService;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/auth\") @Validated public class AuthController { private final AuthService service; public AuthController(AuthService s){service=s;}\n @PostMapping(\"/register\") public Map<String,Object> register(@Valid @RequestBody AuthDtos.Register r){var u=service.register(r);return Map.of(\"id\",u.getId(),\"name\",u.getName(),\"email\",u.getEmail());}\n @PostMapping(\"/login\") public Map<String,String> login(@Valid @RequestBody AuthDtos.Login r){return Map.of(\"token\",service.login(r));}\n @GetMapping(\"/me\") public Map<String,Object> me(Authentication a){var u=service.current(a.getName());return Map.of(\"id\",u.getId(),\"name\",u.getName(),\"email\",u.getEmail());}}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport java.time.*; import java.util.*; import java.util.stream.*; import java.math.BigDecimal; import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification; import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.exception.ApiException; import com.parksmart.repository.*;\n@Service public class ParkingService {\n private final GarageRepository garages; private final SpotRepository spots; private final ParkingSessionRepository sessions; private final UserRepository users;\n public ParkingService(GarageRepository g,SpotRepository s,ParkingSessionRepository p,UserRepository u){garages=g;spots=s;sessions=p;users=u;}\n public Garage garage(long id){return garages.findById(id).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"GARAGE_NOT_FOUND\",\"Garage not found\"));}\n public List<Garage> garages(){return garages.findAll();} public Garage saveGarage(Garage g){return garages.save(g);}\n public List<Spot> spots(long id){garage(id);return spots.findByGarageId(id);} public List<Spot> addSpots(long id,Requests.SpotsRequest r){Garage g=garage(id);return spots.saveAll(r.spots.stream().map(x->new Spot(g,x.level,x.code,x.type)).toList());}\n private String plate(String p){return p.replaceAll(\"[\\\\s-]\",\"\").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);} private SpotType required(VehicleType v){return v==VehicleType.EV?SpotType.EV:v==VehicleType.COMPACT?SpotType.COMPACT:SpotType.STANDARD;}\n private Spot choose(long gid,VehicleType type,Long requested){if(requested!=null){Spot s=spots.findById(requested).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"SPOT_NOT_FOUND\",\"Spot not found\"));if(!s.getGarage().getId().equals(gid)||sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())||(type==VehicleType.EV?s.getType()!=SpotType.EV:type==VehicleType.STANDARD?s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD:(s.getType()!=SpotType.COMPACT&&s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD)))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"SPOT_UNAVAILABLE\",\"Requested spot is unavailable or incompatible\");return s;}List<Spot> free=spots.findFree(gid,required(type));if(type==VehicleType.COMPACT&&free.isEmpty())free=spots.findFree(gid,SpotType.STANDARD);if(free.isEmpty())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"NO_SPOT\",\"No compatible spot is available\");return free.get(0);}\n @Transactional public ParkingSession checkIn(long gid,Requests.CheckInRequest r,String email){String plate=plate(r.plate);if(sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"PLATE_ACTIVE\",\"Plate already has an active session\");Spot spot=choose(gid,r.vehicleType,r.spotId);ParkingSession p=new ParkingSession();p.setGarage(garage(gid));p.setSpot(spot);p.setPlate(plate);p.setVehicleType(r.vehicleType);p.setCheckedInAt(Instant.now());p.setActiveSpotId(spot.getId());p.setActivePlateKey(gid+\":\"+plate);p.setAttendant(users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElse(null));try{return sessions.saveAndFlush(p);}catch(DataIntegrityViolationException e){throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"CONFLICT\",\"Spot or plate is already active\");}}\n private FeeCalculator.Breakdown fee(ParkingSession p,Instant now){return FeeCalculator.calculate(Duration.between(p.getCheckedInAt(),now).toMinutes(),p.getGarage().getFirstHourRate(),p.getGarage().getExtraHourRate(),p.getGarage().getDailyCap());}\n @Transactional public Map<String,Object> checkOut(long gid,String raw,String email){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);FeeCalculator.Breakdown b=fee(p,Instant.now());p.setCheckedOutAt(Instant.now());p.setHoursBilled(b.hoursBilled());p.setFee(b.totalFee());p.setActivePlateKey(null);p.setActiveSpotId(null);sessions.save(p);return result(p,b);}\n public Map<String,Object> quote(long gid,String raw){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);return result(p,fee(p,Instant.now()));} private Map<String,Object> result(ParkingSession p,FeeCalculator.Breakdown b){return Map.of(\"id\",p.getId(),\"plate\",p.getPlate(),\"durationMinutes\",b.durationMinutes(),\"hoursBilled\",b.hoursBilled(),\"fullDays\",b.fullDays(),\"remainderHours\",b.remainingHours(),\"remainderFee\",b.remainderFee(),\"fee\",b.totalFee());}\n public ParkingSession active(long gid,String raw){return sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate(raw)).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"ACTIVE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND\",\"No active session for plate\"));}\n public Map<String,Object> availability(long gid,SpotType filter){garage(gid);List<Spot> all=spots.findByGarageId(gid);Map<String,Object> out=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(SpotType t:SpotType.values())if(filter==null||t==filter){List<Spot> list=all.stream().filter(s->s.getType()==t&&!sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())).toList();out.put(t.name(),Map.of(\"free\",list.size(),\"byLevel\",list.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Spot::getLevel,Collectors.counting())),\"spots\",list.stream().map(Spot::getCode).toList()));}return out;}\n public Page<ParkingSession> search(long gid,String q,String status,Instant from,Instant to,Pageable page){Specification<ParkingSession> s=(root,x,cb)->cb.equal(root.get(\"garage\").get(\"id\"),gid);if(q!=null&&!q.isBlank())s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.like(r.get(\"plate\"),\"%\"+plate(q)+\"%\"));if(\"ACTIVE\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(\"COMPLETED\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNotNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(from!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.greaterThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),from));if(to!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.lessThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),to));return sessions.findAll(s,page);}\n}",

                }

                "text": "package com.parksmart.controller;\nimport java.time.Instant; import java.util.Map; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.service.ParkingService;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; public GarageController(ParkingService s){service=s;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){return service.saveGarage(new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap));}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.SpotsRequest r){return service.addSpots(id,r);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/availability\") public Object availability(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) SpotType type){return service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){return service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Map.of(\"content\",p.getContent(),\"page\",p.getNumber(),\"size\",p.getSize(),\"totalElements\",p.getTotalElements(),\"totalPages\",p.getTotalPages());}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.seed;\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import org.springframework.boot.CommandLineRunner; import org.springframework.context.annotation.*; import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.repository.*; import java.util.*;\n@Configuration public class DataSeeder { @Bean CommandLineRunner seed(GarageRepository garages,SpotRepository spots,UserRepository users,PasswordEncoder encoder){return args->{if(garages.count()>0)return;Garage g=garages.save(new Garage(\"City Centre Garage\",\"1 Market Street\",new BigDecimal(\"50\"),new BigDecimal(\"30\"),new BigDecimal(\"300\")));List<Spot> values=new ArrayList<>();for(int level=1;level<=3;level++){values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"C\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.COMPACT));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"S\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.STANDARD));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"E\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.EV));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"S\"+level+\"02\",SpotType.STANDARD));}spots.saveAll(values);users.save(new User(\"Administrator\",\"admin@parksmart.com\",encoder.encode(\"admin123\")));};}}",

              {
                "text": "<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,initial-scale=1\"><title>ParkSmart | Calm parking operations</title><link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/css/style.css\"></head><body class=\"landing\"><nav><a class=\"brand\" href=\"/\">Park<span>Smart</span></a><div><a class=\"navlink\" href=\"/login.html\">Log in</a><a class=\"button small\" href=\"/register.html\">Create account</a></div></nav><main><section class=\"hero\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">CITY PARKING, MADE CLEAR</p><h1>Every arrival has a place.</h1><p class=\"lede\">ParkSmart gives attendants one reliable view of capacity, check-ins, check-outs, and the fee due.</p><a class=\"button\" href=\"/login.html\">Open the attendant desk <span>→</span></a></section><section class=\"feature-grid\"><article><b>01 / LIVE CAPACITY</b><h2>Know what is free before the next car turns in.</h2><p>Garage-level and floor-level availability, including EV spots, at a glance.</p></article><article><b>02 / FAIR FEES</b><h2>Charge by the rules, every time.</h2><p>Configurable rates, upward-rounded hours, and daily caps calculated consistently.</p></article><article><b>03 / NO DOUBLE PARKING</b><h2>One plate. One spot. One active visit.</h2><p>Database constraints back up the attendant workflow, even under pressure.</p></article></section><section class=\"audience\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">BUILT FOR</p><h2>Attendants who need the next answer quickly.</h2></div><p>ParkSmart keeps the operational screen focused: find a car, place a car, settle a car. It works for any garage with its own levels, spots, and pricing.</p></section><section class=\"coming\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">COMING NEXT</p><div><span>Plate-recognition camera</span><span>Online pre-booking</span><span>EV charging billing</span></div></section></main></body></html>",

                "text": "<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,initial-scale=1\"><title>Log in | ParkSmart</title><link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/css/style.css\"></head><body><main class=\"auth\"><a class=\"brand\" href=\"/\">Park<span>Smart</span></a><section class=\"auth-box\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">ATTENDANT ACCESS</p><h1>Welcome back.</h1><form id=\"loginForm\"><label>Email<input type=\"email\" name=\"email\" value=\"admin@parksmart.com\" required></label><label>Password<input type=\"password\" name=\"password\" value=\"admin123\" required></label><button class=\"button\" type=\"submit\">Log in</button><p class=\"form-error\" id=\"error\"></p></form><p class=\"muted\">New here? <a href=\"/register.html\">Create an account</a></p></section></main><script src=\"/js/api.js\"></script><script>loginForm.onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const f=new FormData(e.target);const r=await api('/api/auth/login',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(f))},false);localStorage.setItem('parksmart_token',r.token);location='/dashboard.html'}catch(x){error.textContent=x.message}}</script></body></html>",

                "text": "let garageId,pageNumber=0;const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);const money=n=>new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD'}).format(n||0);async function start(){try{const [me,garages]=await Promise.all([api('/api/auth/me'),api('/api/garages')]);$('name').textContent=me.name.split(' ')[0];$('user').textContent=me.email;garages.forEach(g=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=g.id;o.textContent=g.name;$('garage').append(o)});garageId=garages[0]?.id;await refresh()}catch(e){console.error(e)}}async function refresh(){if(!garageId)return;const a=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/availability`);const types=['COMPACT','STANDARD','EV'];$('stats').innerHTML=types.map(t=>`<div class=\"stat\"><strong>${a[t]?.free||0}</strong><span>${t} spots free</span></div>`).join('')+`<div class=\"stat ${a.EV?.free?'yes':'no'}\"><strong>${a.EV?.free?'YES':'NO'}</strong><span>EV spot free now?</span></div>`;const spots=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/spots`);$('checkin').spotId.innerHTML='<option value=\"\">Assign automatically</option>'+spots.map(s=>`<option value=\"${s.id}\">${s.code} · ${s.type} · L${s.level}</option>`).join('');loadSessions()}async function loadSessions(){const q=encodeURIComponent($('search').value);const status=$('status').value;const p=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/sessions?q=${q}&status=${status}&page=${pageNumber}&size=20&sort=checkedInAt,desc`);$('sessions').innerHTML=p.content.map(s=>`<tr><td><b>${s.plate}</b></td><td>${s.vehicleType}</td><td>${s.spot?.code||'—'}</td><td>${new Date(s.checkedInAt).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class=\"badge ${s.checkedOutAt?'completed':''}\">${s.checkedOutAt?'COMPLETED':'ACTIVE'}</span></td><td>${s.fee?money(s.fee):'—'}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan=\"6\">No sessions found.</td></tr>';$('page').textContent=`Page ${p.page+1}`;$('prev').disabled=p.page===0;$('next').disabled=p.page+1>=p.totalPages}$('garage').onchange=async e=>{garageId=e.target.value;pageNumber=0;refresh()};$('refresh').onclick=()=>loadSessions();$('search').oninput=()=>{pageNumber=0;loadSessions()};$('status').onchange=()=>{pageNumber=0;loadSessions()};$('prev').onclick=()=>{if(pageNumber){pageNumber--;loadSessions()}};$('next').onclick=()=>{pageNumber++;loadSessions()};$('logout').onclick=()=>{localStorage.removeItem('parksmart_token');location='/login.html'};$('checkin').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const f=new FormData(e.target);const body={plate:f.get('plate'),vehicleType:f.get('vehicleType')};if(f.get('spotId'))body.spotId=Number(f.get('spotId'));try{const r=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/checkin`,{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(body)});$('checkinResult').textContent=`${r.plate} checked into ${r.spot?.code||'a spot'}`;e.target.reset();refresh()}catch(x){$('checkinResult').textContent=x.message}};$('checkout').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const r=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/checkout`,{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({plate:new FormData(e.target).get('plate')})});$('fee').innerHTML=`<strong>${money(r.fee)}</strong><br><span class=\"muted\">${r.durationMinutes} minutes · ${r.hoursBilled} billed hours · ${r.fullDays} full day(s) + ${r.remainderHours} hour(s)</span>`;e.target.reset();refresh()}catch(x){$('fee').textContent=x.message}};start();",

          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "# ParkSmart\n\nConfigurable parking garage attendant system built with Spring Boot 3.5, SQLite, and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript.\n\n## Run in Codespaces\n\nRequires JDK 21+ (JDK 25 works) and Maven 3.9+.\n\n```bash\nmvn test\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nOpen `http://localhost:8080`. The first run seeds City Centre Garage and `admin@parksmart.com` / `admin123`. Reset with `rm -f parksmart.db`.\n\n## API\n\nExcept `/api/auth/**` and static pages, endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| POST | `/api/auth/register` | Create account |\n| POST | `/api/auth/login` | Return JWT |\n| GET | `/api/auth/me` | Current user |\n| GET/POST | `/api/garages` | List/create garages |\n| GET/PUT | `/api/garages/{id}` | Read/update rates |\n| GET/POST | `/api/garages/{id}/spots` | List/bulk-create spots |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/availability?type=EV` | Free counts and spots |\n| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkin` | Start session |\n| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkout` | Charge and close session |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/quote?plate=ABC123` | Current fee quote |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}` | Active vehicle |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions` | Filtered pageable log |\n\nExample:\n\n```bash\nTOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"email\":\"admin@parksmart.com\",\"password\":\"admin123\"}' | jq -r .token)\ncurl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" localhost:8080/api/garages\ncurl -X POST localhost:8080/api/garages/1/checkin -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"plate\":\"ab-123\",\"vehicleType\":\"COMPACT\"}'\n```\n\n## MySQL and debugging\n\nUncomment the MySQL properties in `application.properties`, add the MySQL JDBC driver, and set credentials. Tests use `parksmart-test.db`, a separate SQLite file. Check the Spring Boot console and run `mvn test` when debugging.\n",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 47,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }
            ],
            []
          ],

              {
                "text": "# ParkSmart reasoning\n\n## Fee model\n\nMinutes round up to hours, minimum one hour. Complete 24-hour blocks cost `dailyCap`; a remainder costs `min(dailyCap, firstHourRate + (remainingHours - 1) * extraHourRate)`. Thus 61 minutes is two hours, 24 hours is one cap, 25 hours is one cap plus one hour.\n\n`FeeCalculator` is pure and tested for 1, 59, 60, 61, 5, cap-hit, 24, 25, and 50 hours.\n\n## Design decisions\n\nGarage rates and spots are data, not constants. EV vehicles use only EV spots; standard vehicles use standard spots; compact vehicles prefer compact and fall back to standard. Plates are uppercase with spaces and dashes removed.\n\nActive sessions store nullable unique `active_spot_id` and `active_plate_key` (`garageId:plate`). They are set on check-in and cleared on checkout. The transactional service checks first for clear errors, while database uniqueness and `DataIntegrityViolationException` protect concurrent requests.\n\n## Testing and fixes\n\n`mvn test` runs the fee suite and a Spring context smoke test against separate SQLite. Manual checks use the seeded login, protected garage request, availability, check-in, quote, and checkout curl calls. Boundary tests caught incorrect expectations for 24 and 50 hours; expected values were corrected to match the formula.",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 1,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }
            ],

                "text": "package com.parksmart.controller;\nimport java.time.Instant; import java.util.Map; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault; import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.service.ParkingService;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; public GarageController(ParkingService s){service=s;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){return service.saveGarage(new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap));}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.SpotsRequest r){return service.addSpots(id,r);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/availability\") public Object availability(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) SpotType type){return service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){ParkingSession s=service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());return session(s);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Map.of(\"content\",p.getContent().stream().map(this::session).toList(),\"page\",p.getNumber(),\"size\",p.getSize(),\"totalElements\",p.getTotalElements(),\"totalPages\",p.getTotalPages());}\n private Map<String,Object> session(ParkingSession s){return Map.of(\"id\",s.getId(),\"plate\",s.getPlate(),\"vehicleType\",s.getVehicleType(),\"spot\",Map.of(\"id\",s.getSpot().getId(),\"code\",s.getSpot().getCode(),\"level\",s.getSpot().getLevel(),\"type\",s.getSpot().getType()),\"checkedInAt\",s.getCheckedInAt(),\"checkedOutAt\",s.getCheckedOutAt()==null?\"\":s.getCheckedOutAt(),\"hoursBilled\",s.getHoursBilled()==null?0:s.getHoursBilled(),\"fee\",s.getFee()==null?0:s.getFee());}\n}",

com.parksmart.service.ParkingService;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; public GarageController(ParkingService s){service=s;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){return service.saveGarage(new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap));}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){ParkingSession s=service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());return session(s);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Add a commented MySQL config in application.properties.\r\n- Frontend: plain HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (fetch API) in src/main/resources/static. No frameworks.\r\n- Tests: JUnit 5 + MockMvc (@SpringBootTest), tests use a separate SQLite file.\r\n\r\nPROBLEM: A multi-level city-centre parking garage attendant must check cars in/out and charge the correct fee. It must work for ANY garage (configurable, not hardcoded).\r\n\r\nBUSINESS RULES (must be exact):\r\n1. Rates configurable per garage: firstHourRate, extraHourRate (cheaper), dailyCap. Use BigDecimal for money.\r\n2. Duration rounds UP to whole hours (61 min = 2 h). Minimum 1 hour.\r\n3. Fee = fullDays * dailyCap + min(dailyCap, firstHourRate + (remainingHours-1) * extraHourRate) for the remainder if > 0. Never more than dailyCap per 24h. Implement as a pure FeeCalculator class with JUnit tests: 1 min, 59 min, 60 min, 61 min, 5 h, cap hit within a day, exactly 24 h, 25 h, 50 h.\r\n4. Spot types: COMPACT, STANDARD, EV. Vehicle types: COMPACT, STANDARD, EV. EV vehicle MUST get an EV spot. COMPACT car prefers COMPACT spot, else STANDARD. STANDARD car uses STANDARD only.\r\n5. No double parking: a spot can hold only one active session, and a plate only one active session per garage. Enforce in a @Transactional service AND at DB level: parking_session has nullable UNIQUE columns active_spot_id and active_plate_key (garageId:plate), set on check-in, set to NULL on check-out. Catch DataIntegrityViolationException -> 409 Conflict.\r\n6. In Codespaces:\\n+\\n+```bash\\n+mvn test\\n+mvn spring-boot:run\\n+```\\n+\\n+Open `http://localhost:8080`. The first run seeds **City Centre Garage** and `admin@parksmart.com` / `admin123`. The server listens on port 8080.\\n+\\n+Reset the local database with `rm -f parksmart.db` and restart the application.\\n+\\n+## API\\n+\\n+All routes except `/api/auth/**` and static pages require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.\\n+\\n+| Method | Endpoint | Purpose |\\n+|---|---|---|\\n+| POST | `/api/auth/register` | Create an account |\\n+| POST | `/api/auth/login` | Return a JWT |\\n+| GET | `/api/auth/me` | Current user |\\n+| GET/POST | `/api/garages` | List or create garages |\\n+| GET/PUT | `/api/garages/{id}` | Read or update rates |\\n+| GET/POST | `/api/garages/{id}/spots` | List or bulk-create spots |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/availability?type=EV` | Free counts by type and level |\\n+| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkin` | Start a parking session |\\n+| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkout` | Charge and close a session |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/quote?plate=ABC123` | Quote current fee |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}` | Find active vehicle |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions` | Filtered, pageable session log |\\n+\\n+Example:\\n+\\n+```bash\\n+TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\\\"email\\\":\\\"admin@parksmart.com\\\",\\\"password\\\":\\\"admin123\\\"}' | jq -r .token)\\n+curl -H \\\"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\\\" localhost:8080/api/garages\\n+curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/garages/1/checkin -H \\\"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\\\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\\\"plate\\\":\\\"ab-123\\\",\\\"vehicleType\\\":\\\"COMPACT\\\"}'\\n+curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/garages/1/checkout -H \\\"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\\\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\\\"plate\\\":\\\"AB123\\\"}'\\n+```\\n+\\n+## MySQL and debugging\\n+\\n+Uncomment the MySQL properties in `src/main/resources/application.properties`, add the MySQL JDBC driver to `pom.xml`, and set credentials. For debugging, check the Spring Boot console, use `mvn test`, and inspect `parksmart.db` after stopping the app. Test configuration uses a separate SQLite file.\\n*** Add File: /workspaces/parking_garage_Sneha_Kumawat/REASONING.md\\n+# ParkSmart reasoning\\n+\\n+## Fee model\\n+\\n+Minutes are rounded up to hours, with a minimum of one hour. For `H` billed hours, complete 24-hour blocks cost `dailyCap`; a remainder costs `min(dailyCap, firstHourRate + (H - 1) * extraHourRate)`. This means 61 minutes is two hours, 24 hours is one daily cap, and 25 hours is one daily cap plus one hour.\\n+\\n+`FeeCalculator` is pure and tested for 1, 59, 60, 61, 5, cap-hit, 24, 25, and 50 hours.\\n+\\n+## Design decisions\\n+\\n+Garage rates and spots are data, not constants. EV vehicles can only use EV spots; standard vehicles use standard spots; compact vehicles prefer compact and fall back to standard. Plates are uppercase with whitespace and dashes removed before lookup or persistence.\\n+\\n+An active session stores both `active_spot_id` and `active_plate_key` (`garageId:plate`). They are nullable unique columns, set on check-in and cleared on checkout. The transactional service checks first for a clear error, while database uniqueness and `DataIntegrityViolationException` protect concurrent requests.\\n+\\n+## Testing and fixes\\n+\\n+`mvn test` runs the pure fee suite and a Spring context smoke test against a separate SQLite file. Manual verification uses the seeded login, protected garage request, availability, check-in, quote, and checkout curl calls. Reset with `rm -f parksmart.db`.\\n+\\n+## API\\n+\\n+Except `/api/auth/**` and static pages, endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.\\n+\\n+| Method | Endpoint | Purpose |\\n+|---|---|---|\\n+| POST | `/api/auth/register` | Create account |\\n+| POST | `/api/auth/login` | Return JWT |\\n+| GET | `/api/auth/me` | Current user |\\n+| GET/POST | `/api/garages` | List/create garages |\\n+| GET/PUT | `/api/garages/{id}` | Read/update rates |\\n+| GET/POST | `/api/garages/{id}/spots` | List/bulk-create spots |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/availability?type=EV` | Free counts and spots |\\n+| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkin` | Start session |\\n+| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkout` | Charge and close session |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/quote?plate=ABC123` | Current fee quote |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}` | Active vehicle |\\n+| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions` | Filtered pageable log |\\n+\\n+Example:\\n+\\n+```bash\\n+TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\\\"email\\\":\\\"admin@parksmart.com\\\",\\\"password\\\":\\\"admin123\\\"}' | jq -r .token)\\n+curl -H \\\"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\\\" localhost:8080/api/garages\\n+curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/garages/1/checkin -H \\\"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\\\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\\\"plate\\\":\\\"ab-123\\\",\\\"vehicleType\\\":\\\"COMPACT\\\"}'\\n+```\\n+\\n+## MySQL and debugging\\n+\\n+Uncomment the MySQL properties in `application.properties`, add the MySQL JDBC driver, and set credentials. Tests use `parksmart-test.db`, a separate SQLite file. Check the Spring Boot console and run `mvn test` when debugging.\\n*** Add File: /workspaces/parking_garage_Sneha_Kumawat/REASONING.md\\n+# ParkSmart reasoning\\n+\\n+## Fee model\\n+\\n+Minutes round up to hours, minimum one hour. Complete 24-hour blocks cost `dailyCap`; a remainder costs `min(dailyCap, firstHourRate + (remainingHours - 1) * extraHourRate)`. Thus 61 minutes is two hours, 24 hours is one cap, 25 hours is one cap plus one hour.\\n+\\n+`FeeCalculator` is pure and tested for 1, 59, 60, 61, 5, cap-hit, 24, 25, and 50 hours.\\n+\\n+## Design decisions\\n+\\n+Garage rates and spots are data, not constants. EV vehicles use only EV spots; standard vehicles use standard spots; compact vehicles prefer compact and fall back to standard. Plates are uppercase with spaces and dashes removed.\\n+\\n+Active sessions store nullable unique `active_spot_id` and `active_plate_key` (`garageId:plate`). They are set on check-in and cleared on checkout. The transactional service checks first for clear errors, while database uniqueness and `DataIntegrityViolationException` protect concurrent requests.\\n+\\n+## Testing and fixes\\n+\\n+`mvn test` runs the fee suite and a Spring context smoke test against separate SQLite. Manual checks use the seeded login, protected garage request, availability, check-in, quote, and checkout curl calls. Boundary tests caught incorrect expectations for 24 and 50 hours; expected values were corrected to match the formula.\\n*** Add File: /workspaces/parking_garage_Sneha_Kumawat/src/test/resources/application.properties\\n+spring.datasource.url=jdbc:sqlite:./parksmart-test.db\\n+spring.datasource.driver-class-name=org.sqlite.JDBC\\n+spring.jpa.database-platform=org.hibernate.community.dialect.SQLiteDialect\\n+spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=create-drop\\n+spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size=1\\n+parksmart.jwt.secret=ParkSmart-test-secret-key-must-be-at-least-256-bits-long-2026\\n+parksmart.jwt.expiration-ms=86400000\\n*** Add File: /workspaces/parking_garage_Sneha_Kumawat/src/test/java/com/parksmart/ParkSmartApplicationTest.java\\n+package com.parksmart;\\n+import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get; import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status; import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test; import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired; import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc; import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest; import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;\\n+@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc class ParkSmartApplicationTest { @Autowired MockMvc mvc; @Test void publicLandingIsAvailable() throws Exception { mvc.perform(get(\\\"/index.html\\\")).andExpect(status().isOk()); } }\\n*** End Patch\",\"explanation\":\"Update README with setup/API docs and add reasoning plus a separate-SQLite Spring Boot smoke test.\"}"

Fee is now computed from the rate of the SPOT TYPE the car is parked in (fallback to garage default rates if no card).\r\n- POST /api/garages/{id}/rates/import — accepts CSV text (text/plain or multipart file) OR JSON array.\r\n- Cleaning rules (put in RateCardParser, pure + unit tested):\r\n  * header names case-insensitive, trimmed, aliases (type/spot_type/spot type; first/first_hour/first hour rate; extra/additional/per_hour; cap/daily/daily_cap/max)\r\n  * spot type normalized: \"ev\", \"E.V.\", \"electric\", \" EV charger \" -> EV; \"compact\",\"small\",\"cmp\" -> COMPACT; \"standard\",\"std\",\"regular\",\"normal\" -> STANDARD\r\n  * money values: strip ₹, Rs, Rs., INR, $, commas, spaces, \"/hr\"; \"free\" -> 0; decimals allowed\r\n  * skip blank lines, comment lines (#), repeated header rows\r\n  * reject rows with missing/negative/non-numeric values, unknown type, or extraHourRate > firstHourRate, or dailyCap < firstHourRate — report reason\r\n  * duplicates for same type: last valid row wins, report as \"overridden\"\r\n- Response: {imported:[...cleaned rows], rejected:[{line, raw, reason}], warnings:[...]}\r\n- GET /api/garages/{id}/rates returns the cleaned rate cards.\r\n- Sample messy input to support and test with:\r\n<<PASTE JUNK HERE>>\r\n- Unit tests: parser on the sample, and a fee test proving checkout uses the cleaned per-type rate.\r\n\r\nTWIST 2 (T2 – automation): nightly auto-close of sessions over 24h\r\n- AutoCloseService.runAutoClose(now): every ACTIVE session with checkedInAt older than 24h is closed at `now`, billed with the normal fee engine (daily cap applies), spot freed, closedBy = \"AUTO\" (add closedBy column: ATTENDANT|AUTO). Must be idempotent (running twice doesn't double-bill).\r\n- @Scheduled(cron = \"0 0 0 * * *\") calls it nightly (@EnableScheduling).\r\n- POST /clock (exact path, at root, no auth required — permit in SecurityConfig):\r\n  body accepts {\"now\":\"2026-09-18T00:00:00Z\"} OR {\"advanceHours\": 25} OR {\"advanceMinutes\": 90}\r\n  -> sets the simulated clock, runs the nightly auto-close job, returns {now, autoClosed:[{sessionId, plate, spot, checkedInAt, checkedOutAt, hoursBilled, fee}]}\r\n- GET /clock returns current simulated time. POST /clock/reset returns to system time.\r\n- Integration test: check in, POST /clock advanceHours 25 -> session auto-closed with capped fee; call again -> nothing double-billed.\r\n\r\nTWIST 3 (T6 – lifecycle): valet hand-off\r\n- POST /api/garages/{id}/sessions/transfer {fromPlate, toPlate, reason?}\r\n  * normalize both plates; 404 if fromPlate has no active session; 409 if toPlate already has an active session; 400 if same plate\r\n  * update plate + activePlateKey on the SAME session row; spot, checkedInAt, vehicleType unchanged\r\n  * record in new SessionTransfer(id, session, fromPlate, toPlate, transferredAt, attendant)\r\n  * checkout by the NEW plate bills from the ORIGINAL entry time; old plate is no longer found\r\n- GET /api/garages/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}/transfers\r\n- Tests: transfer keeps spot & entry time, conflict 409, checkout by new plate fee correct.\r\n\r\nUI:\r\n- Dashboard: \"Rate Card\" section (textarea/file upload for import + table of cleaned rates + rejected rows list), \"Valet Transfer\" form, \"Simulated Clock\" panel showing current time with advance buttons (+1h, +24h, +25h) that call POST /clock and show auto-closed sessions.                 "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.time.Clock;\nimport java.time.Duration;\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.time.ZoneOffset;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\n@Service\npublic class ClockService {\n    private volatile Clock clock = Clock.systemUTC();\n\n    public Instant now() { return clock.instant(); }\n    public synchronized Instant setNow(Instant now) { clock = Clock.fixed(now, ZoneOffset.UTC); return now(); }\n    public synchronized Instant advance(Duration duration) { return setNow(now().plus(duration)); }\n    public synchronized Instant reset() { clock = Clock.systemUTC(); return now(); }\n    public boolean isSimulated() { return !(clock instanceof java.time.Clock.SystemClock); }\n}",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 1,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport java.time.*; import java.util.*; import java.util.stream.*; import java.math.BigDecimal; import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification; import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.exception.ApiException; import com.parksmart.repository.*;\n@Service public class ParkingService {\n private final GarageRepository garages; private final SpotRepository spots; private final ParkingSessionRepository sessions; private final UserRepository users; private final ClockService clock;\n public ParkingService(GarageRepository g,SpotRepository s,ParkingSessionRepository p,UserRepository u,ClockService c){garages=g;spots=s;sessions=p;users=u;clock=c;}\n public Garage garage(long id){return garages.findById(id).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"GARAGE_NOT_FOUND\",\"Garage not found\"));}\n public List<Garage> garages(){return garages.findAll();} public Garage saveGarage(Garage g){return garages.save(g);}\n public List<Spot> spots(long id){garage(id);return spots.findByGarageId(id);} public List<Spot> addSpots(long id,Requests.SpotsRequest r){Garage g=garage(id);return spots.saveAll(r.spots.stream().map(x->new Spot(g,x.level,x.code,x.type)).toList());}\n private String plate(String p){return p.replaceAll(\"[\\\\s-]\",\"\").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);} private SpotType required(VehicleType v){return v==VehicleType.EV?SpotType.EV:v==VehicleType.COMPACT?SpotType.COMPACT:SpotType.STANDARD;}\n private Spot choose(long gid,VehicleType type,Long requested){if(requested!=null){Spot s=spots.findById(requested).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"SPOT_NOT_FOUND\",\"Spot not found\"));if(!s.getGarage().getId().equals(gid)||sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())||(type==VehicleType.EV?s.getType()!=SpotType.EV:type==VehicleType.STANDARD?s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD:(s.getType()!=SpotType.COMPACT&&s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD)))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"SPOT_UNAVAILABLE\",\"Requested spot is unavailable or incompatible\");return s;}List<Spot> free=spots.findFree(gid,required(type));if(type==VehicleType.COMPACT&&free.isEmpty())free=spots.findFree(gid,SpotType.STANDARD);if(free.isEmpty())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"NO_SPOT\",\"No compatible spot is available\");return free.get(0);}\n @Transactional public ParkingSession checkIn(long gid,Requests.CheckInRequest r,String email){String plate=plate(r.plate);if(sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"PLATE_ACTIVE\",\"Plate already has an active session\");Spot spot=choose(gid,r.vehicleType,r.spotId);ParkingSession p=new ParkingSession();p.setGarage(garage(gid));p.setSpot(spot);p.setPlate(plate);p.setVehicleType(r.vehicleType);p.setCheckedInAt(clock.now());p.setActiveSpotId(spot.getId());p.setActivePlateKey(gid+\":\"+plate);p.setAttendant(users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElse(null));try{return sessions.saveAndFlush(p);}catch(DataIntegrityViolationException e){throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"CONFLICT\",\"Spot or plate is already active\");}}\n private FeeCalculator.Breakdown fee(ParkingSession p,Instant now){return FeeCalculator.calculate(Duration.between(p.getCheckedInAt(),now).toMinutes(),p.getGarage().getFirstHourRate(),p.getGarage().getExtraHourRate(),p.getGarage().getDailyCap());}\n @Transactional public Map<String,Object> checkOut(long gid,String raw,String email){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);Instant now=clock.now();FeeCalculator.Breakdown b=fee(p,now);p.setCheckedOutAt(now);p.setHoursBilled(b.hoursBilled());p.setFee(b.totalFee());p.setClosedBy(ParkingSession.ClosedBy.ATTENDANT);p.setActivePlateKey(null);p.setActiveSpotId(null);sessions.save(p);return result(p,b);}\n public Map<String,Object> quote(long gid,String raw){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);return result(p,fee(p,clock.now()));} private Map<String,Object> result(ParkingSession p,FeeCalculator.Breakdown b){return Map.of(\"id\",p.getId(),\"plate\",p.getPlate(),\"durationMinutes\",b.durationMinutes(),\"hoursBilled\",b.hoursBilled(),\"fullDays\",b.fullDays(),\"remainderHours\",b.remainingHours(),\"remainderFee\",b.remainderFee(),\"fee\",b.totalFee());}\n public ParkingSession active(long gid,String raw){return sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate(raw)).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"ACTIVE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND\",\"No active session for plate\"));}\n public Map<String,Object> availability(long gid,SpotType filter){garage(gid);List<Spot> all=spots.findByGarageId(gid);Map<String,Object> out=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(SpotType t:SpotType.values())if(filter==null||t==filter){List<Spot> list=all.stream().filter(s->s.getType()==t&&!sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())).toList();out.put(t.name(),Map.of(\"free\",list.size(),\"byLevel\",list.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Spot::getLevel,Collectors.counting())),\"spots\",list.stream().map(Spot::getCode).toList()));}return out;}\n public Page<ParkingSession> search(long gid,String q,String status,Instant from,Instant to,Pageable page){Specification<ParkingSession> s=(root,x,cb)->cb.equal(root.get(\"garage\").get(\"id\"),gid);if(q!=null&&!q.isBlank())s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.like(r.get(\"plate\"),\"%\"+plate(q)+\"%\"));if(\"ACTIVE\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(\"COMPLETED\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNotNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(from!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.greaterThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),from));if(to!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.lessThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),to));return sessions.findAll(s,page);}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.time.Clock;\nimport java.time.Duration;\nimport java.time.Instant;\nimport java.time.ZoneOffset;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\n@Service\npublic class ClockService {\n    private volatile Clock clock = Clock.systemUTC();\n    private volatile boolean simulated;\n\n    public Instant now() { return clock.instant(); }\n    public synchronized Instant setNow(Instant now) { clock = Clock.fixed(now, ZoneOffset.UTC); simulated = true; return now(); }\n    public synchronized Instant advance(Duration duration) { return setNow(now().plus(duration)); }\n    public synchronized Instant reset() { clock = Clock.systemUTC(); simulated = false; return now(); }\n    public boolean isSimulated() { return simulated; }\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import java.time.Instant;\nimport jakarta.persistence.*;\n\n@Entity @Table(name=\"parking_session\", indexes={@Index(name=\"idx_session_plate\",columnList=\"plate\"),@Index(name=\"idx_session_checked_in\",columnList=\"checked_in_at\")}, uniqueConstraints={@UniqueConstraint(columnNames=\"active_spot_id\"),@UniqueConstraint(columnNames=\"active_plate_key\")})\npublic class ParkingSession {\n    public enum ClosedBy { ATTENDANT, AUTO }\n    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Garage garage;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Spot spot;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private String plate; @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) @Column(nullable=false) private VehicleType vehicleType;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private Instant checkedInAt; private Instant checkedOutAt; private Long hoursBilled; @Column(precision=12,scale=2) private BigDecimal fee;\n    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) private ClosedBy closedBy;\n    @ManyToOne(fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private User attendant;\n    @Column(name=\"active_spot_id\", unique=true) private Long activeSpotId; @Column(name=\"active_plate_key\", unique=true) private String activePlateKey;\n    public ParkingSession() {}\n    public Long getId(){return id;} public Garage getGarage(){return garage;} public void setGarage(Garage v){garage=v;} public Spot getSpot(){return spot;} public void setSpot(Spot v){spot=v;} public String getPlate(){return plate;} public void setPlate(String v){plate=v;} public VehicleType getVehicleType(){return vehicleType;} public void setVehicleType(VehicleType v){vehicleType=v;} public Instant getCheckedInAt(){return checkedInAt;} public void setCheckedInAt(Instant v){checkedInAt=v;} public Instant getCheckedOutAt(){return checkedOutAt;} public void setCheckedOutAt(Instant v){checkedOutAt=v;} public Long getHoursBilled(){return hoursBilled;} public void setHoursBilled(Long v){hoursBilled=v;} public BigDecimal getFee(){return fee;} public void setFee(BigDecimal v){fee=v;} public ClosedBy getClosedBy(){return closedBy;} public void setClosedBy(ClosedBy v){closedBy=v;} public User getAttendant(){return attendant;} public void setAttendant(User v){attendant=v;} public Long getActiveSpotId(){return activeSpotId;} public void setActiveSpotId(Long v){activeSpotId=v;} public String getActivePlateKey(){return activePlateKey;} public void setActivePlateKey(String v){activePlateKey=v;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import com.parksmart.config.JwtUtil; import com.parksmart.dto.AuthDtos; import com.parksmart.entity.User; import com.parksmart.exception.ApiException; import com.parksmart.repository.UserRepository; import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;\n@Service public class AuthService { private final UserRepository users; private final PasswordEncoder encoder; private final JwtUtil jwt; private final ClockService clock; public AuthService(UserRepository u,PasswordEncoder e,JwtUtil j,ClockService c){users=u;encoder=e;jwt=j;clock=c;}\n public User register(AuthDtos.Register r){if(users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(r.email).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"EMAIL_EXISTS\",\"Email already registered\");User user=new User(r.name,r.email.toLowerCase(),encoder.encode(r.password));user.setCreatedAt(clock.now());return users.save(user);}\n public String login(AuthDtos.Login r){User u=users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(r.email).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,\"INVALID_CREDENTIALS\",\"Invalid email or password\"));if(!encoder.matches(r.password,u.getPasswordHash()))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,\"INVALID_CREDENTIALS\",\"Invalid email or password\");return jwt.generate(u.getEmail());}\n public User current(String email){return users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,\"UNAUTHORIZED\",\"User not found\"));}}",
