                "text": "package com.parksmart.controller;\nimport java.time.Instant; import java.util.Map; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault; import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.service.ClockService; import com.parksmart.service.ParkingService;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; private final ClockService clock; public GarageController(ParkingService s,ClockService c){service=s;clock=c;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap);g.setCreatedAt(clock.now());return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.SpotsRequest r){return service.addSpots(id,r);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/availability\") public Object availability(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) SpotType type){return service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){ParkingSession s=service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());return session(s);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Map.of(\"content\",p.getContent().stream().map(this::session).toList(),\"page\",p.getNumber(),\"size\",p.getSize(),\"totalElements\",p.getTotalElements(),\"totalPages\",p.getTotalPages());}\n private Map<String,Object> session(ParkingSession s){Map<String,Object> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();result.put(\"id\",s.getId());result.put(\"plate\",s.getPlate());result.put(\"vehicleType\",s.getVehicleType());result.put(\"spot\",Map.of(\"id\",s.getSpot().getId(),\"code\",s.getSpot().getCode(),\"level\",s.getSpot().getLevel(),\"type\",s.getSpot().getType()));result.put(\"checkedInAt\",s.getCheckedInAt());result.put(\"checkedOutAt\",s.getCheckedOutAt());result.put(\"hoursBilled\",s.getHoursBilled()==null?0:s.getHoursBilled());result.put(\"fee\",s.getFee()==null?0:s.getFee());return result;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.seed;\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import org.springframework.boot.CommandLineRunner; import org.springframework.context.annotation.*; import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.repository.*; import com.parksmart.service.ClockService; import java.util.*;\n@Configuration public class DataSeeder { @Bean CommandLineRunner seed(GarageRepository garages,SpotRepository spots,UserRepository users,PasswordEncoder encoder,ClockService clock){return args->{if(garages.count()>0)return;Garage garage=new Garage(\"City Centre Garage\",\"1 Market Street\",new BigDecimal(\"50\"),new BigDecimal(\"30\"),new BigDecimal(\"300\"));garage.setCreatedAt(clock.now());Garage g=garages.save(garage);List<Spot> values=new ArrayList<>();for(int level=1;level<=3;level++){values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"C\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.COMPACT));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"S\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.STANDARD));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"E\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.EV));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"S\"+level+\"02\",SpotType.STANDARD));}spots.saveAll(values);User user=new User(\"Administrator\",\"admin@parksmart.com\",encoder.encode(\"admin123\"));user.setCreatedAt(clock.now());users.save(user);};}}",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,

                  "endLineNumber": 4,

                }

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import java.time.Instant; import jakarta.persistence.*;\n\n@Entity @Table(name=\"rate_card\", uniqueConstraints=@UniqueConstraint(columnNames={\"garage_id\",\"spot_type\"}))\npublic class RateCard {\n    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id;\n    @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private Garage garage;\n    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) @Column(name=\"spot_type\",nullable=false) private SpotType spotType;\n    @Column(nullable=false,precision=12,scale=2) private BigDecimal firstHourRate;\n    @Column(nullable=false,precision=12,scale=2) private BigDecimal extraHourRate;\n    @Column(nullable=false,precision=12,scale=2) private BigDecimal dailyCap;\n    @Column(nullable=false) private Instant updatedAt;\n    public RateCard() {}\n    public RateCard(Garage garage,SpotType spotType,BigDecimal first,BigDecimal extra,BigDecimal cap,Instant updated){this.garage=garage;this.spotType=spotType;firstHourRate=first;extraHourRate=extra;dailyCap=cap;updatedAt=updated;}\n    public Long getId(){return id;} public Garage getGarage(){return garage;} public void setGarage(Garage v){garage=v;} public SpotType getSpotType(){return spotType;} public void setSpotType(SpotType v){spotType=v;} public BigDecimal getFirstHourRate(){return firstHourRate;} public void setFirstHourRate(BigDecimal v){firstHourRate=v;} public BigDecimal getExtraHourRate(){return extraHourRate;} public void setExtraHourRate(BigDecimal v){extraHourRate=v;} public BigDecimal getDailyCap(){return dailyCap;} public void setDailyCap(BigDecimal v){dailyCap=v;} public Instant getUpdatedAt(){return updatedAt;} public void setUpdatedAt(Instant v){updatedAt=v;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import java.util.*; import com.parksmart.entity.SpotType;\n\npublic final class RateCardParser {\n    private RateCardParser() {}\n    public record Row(SpotType spotType,BigDecimal firstHourRate,BigDecimal extraHourRate,BigDecimal dailyCap) {}\n    public record Rejected(int line,String raw,String reason) {}\n    public record Result(List<Row> imported,List<Rejected> rejected,List<String> warnings) {}\n    public static Result parse(String input) {\n        List<Row> imported=new ArrayList<>(); List<Rejected> rejected=new ArrayList<>(); List<String> warnings=new ArrayList<>(); Map<SpotType,Integer> positions=new EnumMap<>(SpotType.class);\n        String[] lines=input==null?new String[0]:input.split(\"\\\\R\",-1); boolean headerFound=false;\n        for(int i=0;i<lines.length;i++){String raw=lines[i];String text=raw.trim();if(text.isEmpty()||text.startsWith(\"#\"))continue;String[] cells=split(raw);\n            if(!headerFound){Map<String,Integer> headers=new HashMap<>();for(int j=0;j<cells.length;j++)headers.put(normal(cells[j]),j);if(!headers.containsKey(\"type\")||!headers.containsKey(\"first\")||!headers.containsKey(\"extra\")||!headers.containsKey(\"cap\")){rejected.add(new Rejected(i+1,raw,\"missing required header\"));continue;}positions.put(SpotType.COMPACT,headers.get(\"type\"));positions.put(SpotType.STANDARD,headers.get(\"type\"));positions.put(SpotType.EV,headers.get(\"type\"));positions.put(null,headers.get(\"first\"));positions.put(null,headers.get(\"extra\"));headerFound=true;continue;}\n            if(isHeader(cells)){continue;} try {Row row=clean(cells,positions);if(positions.containsKey(row.spotType())){warnings.add(\"line \"+(i+1)+\" \"+row.spotType()+\" overridden\");imported.removeIf(x->x.spotType()==row.spotType());}imported.add(row);positions.put(row.spotType(),i);}catch(IllegalArgumentException e){rejected.add(new Rejected(i+1,raw,e.getMessage()));}\n        } return new Result(imported,rejected,warnings);\n    }\n    private static Row clean(String[] c,Map<SpotType,Integer> p){String type=value(c,0);SpotType spot=type(type);BigDecimal first=money(value(c,1)),extra=money(value(c,2)),cap=money(value(c,3));if(first.signum()<0||extra.signum()<0||cap.signum()<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"negative money value\");if(extra.compareTo(first)>0)throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"extraHourRate greater than firstHourRate\");if(cap.compareTo(first)<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"dailyCap less than firstHourRate\");return new Row(spot,first,extra,cap);}\n    private static String value(String[] c,int i){if(i>=c.length||c[i].trim().isEmpty())throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"missing value\");return c[i].trim();}\n    private static BigDecimal money(String s){if(s.equalsIgnoreCase(\"free\"))return BigDecimal.ZERO;String v=s.replaceAll(\"(?i)rs\\\\.?|inr|₹|\\\\$|/hr|[,\\\\s]\",\"\");try{return new BigDecimal(v);}catch(Exception e){throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"non-numeric money value\");}}\n    private static SpotType type(String s){String v=s.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll(\"[^a-z]\",\"\");return switch(v){case \"ev\",\"electric\",\"evcharger\"->SpotType.EV;case \"compact\",\"small\",\"cmp\"->SpotType.COMPACT;case \"standard\",\"std\",\"regular\",\"normal\"->SpotType.STANDARD;default->throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"unknown spot type\");};}\n    private static String normal(String s){String v=s.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll(\"[ _-]\",\"\");return switch(v){case \"type\",\"spottype\"->\"type\";case \"first\",\"firsthour\",\"firsthourrate\"->\"first\";case \"extra\",\"additional\",\"perhour\",\"extrahour\",\"extrahourrate\"->\"extra\";case \"cap\",\"daily\",\"dailycap\",\"max\"->\"cap\";default->v;};}\n    private static boolean isHeader(String[] c){return c.length>0&&normal(c[0]).equals(\"type\")&&c.length>1&&normal(c[1]).equals(\"first\");}\n    private static String[] split(String line){return line.split(\",\",-1);}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.util.*; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.repository.RateCardRepository;\n\n@Service public class RateCardService {\n    private final RateCardRepository cards; private final ParkingService parking; private final ClockService clock;\n    public RateCardService(RateCardRepository c,ParkingService p,ClockService clock){cards=c;parking=p;this.clock=clock;}\n    public List<RateCard> find(long garageId){parking.garage(garageId);return cards.findByGarageId(garageId);}\n    @Transactional public RateCardParser.Result importText(long garageId,String text){Garage garage=parking.garage(garageId);RateCardParser.Result result=RateCardParser.parse(text);for(RateCardParser.Row row:result.imported()){RateCard card=cards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(garageId,row.spotType()).orElseGet(RateCard::new);card.setGarage(garage);card.setSpotType(row.spotType());card.setFirstHourRate(row.firstHourRate());card.setExtraHourRate(row.extraHourRate());card.setDailyCap(row.dailyCap());card.setUpdatedAt(clock.now());cards.save(card);}return result;}\n    public RateCard rateFor(Spot spot){return cards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(spot.getGarage().getId(),spot.getType()).orElse(null);}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport java.time.*; import java.util.*; import java.util.stream.*; import java.math.BigDecimal; import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification; import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.exception.ApiException; import com.parksmart.repository.*;\n@Service public class ParkingService {\n private final GarageRepository garages; private final SpotRepository spots; private final ParkingSessionRepository sessions; private final UserRepository users; private final ClockService clock; private final RateCardRepository rateCards;\n public ParkingService(GarageRepository g,SpotRepository s,ParkingSessionRepository p,UserRepository u,ClockService c,RateCardRepository rates){garages=g;spots=s;sessions=p;users=u;clock=c;rateCards=rates;}\n public Garage garage(long id){return garages.findById(id).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"GARAGE_NOT_FOUND\",\"Garage not found\"));}\n public List<Garage> garages(){return garages.findAll();} public Garage saveGarage(Garage g){return garages.save(g);}\n public List<Spot> spots(long id){garage(id);return spots.findByGarageId(id);} public List<Spot> addSpots(long id,Requests.SpotsRequest r){Garage g=garage(id);return spots.saveAll(r.spots.stream().map(x->new Spot(g,x.level,x.code,x.type)).toList());}\n private String plate(String p){return p.replaceAll(\"[\\\\s-]\",\"\").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);} private SpotType required(VehicleType v){return v==VehicleType.EV?SpotType.EV:v==VehicleType.COMPACT?SpotType.COMPACT:SpotType.STANDARD;}\n private Spot choose(long gid,VehicleType type,Long requested){if(requested!=null){Spot s=spots.findById(requested).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"SPOT_NOT_FOUND\",\"Spot not found\"));if(!s.getGarage().getId().equals(gid)||sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())||(type==VehicleType.EV?s.getType()!=SpotType.EV:type==VehicleType.STANDARD?s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD:(s.getType()!=SpotType.COMPACT&&s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD)))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"SPOT_UNAVAILABLE\",\"Requested spot is unavailable or incompatible\");return s;}List<Spot> free=spots.findFree(gid,required(type));if(type==VehicleType.COMPACT&&free.isEmpty())free=spots.findFree(gid,SpotType.STANDARD);if(free.isEmpty())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"NO_SPOT\",\"No compatible spot is available\");return free.get(0);}\n @Transactional public ParkingSession checkIn(long gid,Requests.CheckInRequest r,String email){String plate=plate(r.plate);if(sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"PLATE_ACTIVE\",\"Plate already has an active session\");Spot spot=choose(gid,r.vehicleType,r.spotId);ParkingSession p=new ParkingSession();p.setGarage(garage(gid));p.setSpot(spot);p.setPlate(plate);p.setVehicleType(r.vehicleType);p.setCheckedInAt(clock.now());p.setActiveSpotId(spot.getId());p.setActivePlateKey(gid+\":\"+plate);p.setAttendant(users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElse(null));try{return sessions.saveAndFlush(p);}catch(DataIntegrityViolationException e){throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"CONFLICT\",\"Spot or plate is already active\");}}\n private FeeCalculator.Breakdown fee(ParkingSession p,Instant now){RateCard rate=rateCards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(p.getGarage().getId(),p.getSpot().getType()).orElse(null);return FeeCalculator.calculate(Duration.between(p.getCheckedInAt(),now).toMinutes(),rate==null?p.getGarage().getFirstHourRate():rate.getFirstHourRate(),rate==null?p.getGarage().getExtraHourRate():rate.getExtraHourRate(),rate==null?p.getGarage().getDailyCap():rate.getDailyCap());}\n @Transactional public Map<String,Object> checkOut(long gid,String raw,String email){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);Instant now=clock.now();FeeCalculator.Breakdown b=fee(p,now);p.setCheckedOutAt(now);p.setHoursBilled(b.hoursBilled());p.setFee(b.totalFee());p.setClosedBy(ParkingSession.ClosedBy.ATTENDANT);p.setActivePlateKey(null);p.setActiveSpotId(null);sessions.save(p);return result(p,b);}\n public Map<String,Object> quote(long gid,String raw){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);return result(p,fee(p,clock.now()));} private Map<String,Object> result(ParkingSession p,FeeCalculator.Breakdown b){return Map.of(\"id\",p.getId(),\"plate\",p.getPlate(),\"durationMinutes\",b.durationMinutes(),\"hoursBilled\",b.hoursBilled(),\"fullDays\",b.fullDays(),\"remainderHours\",b.remainingHours(),\"remainderFee\",b.remainderFee(),\"fee\",b.totalFee());}\n public ParkingSession active(long gid,String raw){return sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate(raw)).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"ACTIVE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND\",\"No active session for plate\"));}\n public Map<String,Object> availability(long gid,SpotType filter){garage(gid);List<Spot> all=spots.findByGarageId(gid);Map<String,Object> out=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(SpotType t:SpotType.values())if(filter==null||t==filter){List<Spot> list=all.stream().filter(s->s.getType()==t&&!sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())).toList();out.put(t.name(),Map.of(\"free\",list.size(),\"byLevel\",list.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Spot::getLevel,Collectors.counting())),\"spots\",list.stream().map(Spot::getCode).toList()));}return out;}\n public Page<ParkingSession> search(long gid,String q,String status,Instant from,Instant to,Pageable page){Specification<ParkingSession> s=(root,x,cb)->cb.equal(root.get(\"garage\").get(\"id\"),gid);if(q!=null&&!q.isBlank())s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.like(r.get(\"plate\"),\"%\"+plate(q)+\"%\"));if(\"ACTIVE\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(\"COMPLETED\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNotNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(from!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.greaterThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),from));if(to!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.lessThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),to));return sessions.findAll(s,page);}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.controller;\nimport java.time.Instant; import java.util.Map; import java.util.List; import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode; import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault; import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.service.*;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; private final ClockService clock; private final RateCardService rates; private final ObjectMapper mapper; public GarageController(ParkingService s,ClockService c,RateCardService r,ObjectMapper m){service=s;clock=c;rates=r;mapper=m;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap);g.setCreatedAt(clock.now());return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/rates\") public Object rates(@PathVariable long id){return rates.find(id);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"text/plain\") public Object importText(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody String text){return rates.importText(id,text);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"application/json\") public Object importJson(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody JsonNode body){try{return rates.importText(id,mapper.writeValueAsString(body).replace(\"[\",\"type,first,extra,cap\\n\").replace(\"]\",\"\").replace(\"{\",\" \").replace(\"}\",\"\").replace(\"\\\"type\\\":\",\"\\\"\").replace(\"\\\"spotType\\\":\",\"\\\"\").replace(\"\\\"firstHourRate\\\":\",\"\").replace(\"\\\"extraHourRate\\\":\",\"\").replace(\"\\\"dailyCap\\\":\",\"\"));}catch(Exception e){throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid rate card JSON\");}}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.SpotsRequest r){return service.addSpots(id,r);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/availability\") public Object availability(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) SpotType type){return service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){ParkingSession s=service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());return session(s);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Map.of(\"content\",p.getContent().stream().map(this::session).toList(),\"page\",p.getNumber(),\"size\",p.getSize(),\"totalElements\",p.getTotalElements(),\"totalPages\",p.getTotalPages());}\n private Map<String,Object> session(ParkingSession s){Map<String,Object> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();result.put(\"id\",s.getId());result.put(\"plate\",s.getPlate());result.put(\"vehicleType\",s.getVehicleType());result.put(\"spot\",Map.of(\"id\",s.getSpot().getId(),\"code\",s.getSpot().getCode(),\"level\",s.getSpot().getLevel(),\"type\",s.getSpot().getType()));result.put(\"checkedInAt\",s.getCheckedInAt());result.put(\"checkedOutAt\",s.getCheckedOutAt());result.put(\"hoursBilled\",s.getHoursBilled()==null?0:s.getHoursBilled());result.put(\"fee\",s.getFee()==null?0:s.getFee());return result;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test; import com.parksmart.entity.SpotType;\nclass RateCardParserTest { @Test void cleansMessyRowsAndReportsBadData(){String csv=\" TYPE , First Hour Rate , additional , MAX\\n# ignore\\n electric , INR 100 , $40/hr , 500\\nsmall,₹50,Rs. 20,300\\nstd,free,30,300\\ncompact,60,25,300\\nunknown,1,1,2\\n\";var r=RateCardParser.parse(csv);assertEquals(3,r.imported().size());assertEquals(1,r.rejected().size());assertTrue(r.warnings().get(0).contains(\"overridden\"));assertEquals(SpotType.EV,r.imported().get(0).spotType());assertEquals(0,r.imported().get(2).firstHourRate().signum());} }",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.util.*; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.repository.RateCardRepository;\n\n@Service public class RateCardService {\n    private final RateCardRepository cards; private final ParkingService parking; private final ClockService clock;\n    public RateCardService(RateCardRepository c,ParkingService p,ClockService clock){cards=c;parking=p;this.clock=clock;}\n    public List<RateCard> find(long garageId){parking.garage(garageId);return cards.findByGarageId(garageId);}\n    @Transactional public RateCardParser.Result importText(long garageId,String text){Garage garage=parking.garage(garageId);RateCardParser.Result result=RateCardParser.parse(text);for(RateCardParser.Row row:result.imported()){RateCard card=cards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(garageId,row.spotType()).orElseGet(RateCard::new);card.setGarage(garage);card.setSpotType(row.spotType());card.setFirstHourRate(row.firstHourRate());card.setExtraHourRate(row.extraHourRate());card.setDailyCap(row.dailyCap());card.setUpdatedAt(clock.now());cards.save(card);}return result;}\n    public RateCardParser.Result importRows(long garageId,JsonNode body){StringBuilder csv=new StringBuilder(\"type,first,extra,cap\\n\");for(JsonNode row:body)csv.append(row.path(\"type\").asText(row.path(\"spotType\").asText())).append(',').append(row.path(\"first\").asText(row.path(\"firstHourRate\").asText())).append(',').append(row.path(\"extra\").asText(row.path(\"extraHourRate\").asText())).append(',').append(row.path(\"cap\").asText(row.path(\"dailyCap\").asText())).append('\\n');return importText(garageId,csv.toString());}\n    public RateCard rateFor(Spot spot){return cards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(spot.getGarage().getId(),spot.getType()).orElse(null);}\n}",

com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault; import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.service.*;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; private final ClockService clock; private final RateCardService rates; private final ObjectMapper mapper; public GarageController(ParkingService s,ClockService c,RateCardService r,ObjectMapper m){service=s;clock=c;rates=r;mapper=m;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap);g.setCreatedAt(clock.now());return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/rates\") public Object rates(@PathVariable long id){return rates.find(id);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"text/plain\") public Object importText(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody String text){return rates.importText(id,text);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"application/json\") public Object importJson(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody JsonNode body){return rates.importRows(id,body);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.SpotsRequest r){return service.addSpots(id,r);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/availability\") public Object availability(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) SpotType type){return service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){ParkingSession s=service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());return session(s);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Map.of(\"content\",p.getContent().stream().map(this::session).toList(),\"page\",p.getNumber(),\"size\",p.getSize(),\"totalElements\",p.getTotalElements(),\"totalPages\",p.getTotalPages());}\n private Map<String,Object> session(ParkingSession s){Map<String,Object> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();result.put(\"id\",s.getId());result.put(\"plate\",s.getPlate());result.put(\"vehicleType\",s.getVehicleType());result.put(\"spot\",Map.of(\"id\",s.getSpot().getId(),\"code\",s.getSpot().getCode(),\"level\",s.getSpot().getLevel(),\"type\",s.getSpot().getType()));result.put(\"checkedInAt\",s.getCheckedInAt());result.put(\"checkedOutAt\",s.getCheckedOutAt());result.put(\"hoursBilled\",s.getHoursBilled()==null?0:s.getHoursBilled());result.put(\"fee\",s.getFee()==null?0:s.getFee());return result;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test; import com.parksmart.entity.SpotType;\nclass RateCardParserTest { @Test void cleansMessyRowsAndReportsBadData(){String csv=\" TYPE , First Hour Rate , additional , MAX\\n# ignore\\n electric , INR 100 , $40/hr , 500\\nsmall,₹50,Rs. 20,300\\nstd,free,free,300\\ncompact,60,25,300\\nunknown,1,1,2\\n\";var r=RateCardParser.parse(csv);assertEquals(3,r.imported().size());assertEquals(1,r.rejected().size());assertTrue(r.warnings().get(0).contains(\"overridden\"));assertEquals(SpotType.EV,r.imported().get(0).spotType());assertEquals(0,r.imported().get(2).firstHourRate().signum());} }",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.repository;\nimport java.util.*; import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.*; import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification; import com.parksmart.entity.ParkingSession;\npublic interface ParkingSessionRepository extends JpaRepository<ParkingSession,Long>, JpaSpecificationExecutor<ParkingSession>{Optional<ParkingSession> findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(Long garageId,String key); List<ParkingSession> findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKeyIsNotNull(Long garageId); List<ParkingSession> findByCheckedOutAtIsNullAndCheckedInAtBefore(java.time.Instant before); boolean existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(Long garageId,Long spotId);}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import java.time.*; import java.util.*; import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.repository.*;\n\n@Service public class AutoCloseService {\n    private final ParkingSessionRepository sessions; private final RateCardRepository rates;\n    public AutoCloseService(ParkingSessionRepository s,RateCardRepository r){sessions=s;rates=r;}\n    @Scheduled(cron=\"0 0 0 * * *\") public void nightly(){runAutoClose(Instant.now());}\n    @Transactional public List<Map<String,Object>> runAutoClose(Instant now){List<Map<String,Object>> closed=new ArrayList<>();for(ParkingSession session:sessions.findByCheckedOutAtIsNullAndCheckedInAtBefore(now.minus(24,java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.HOURS))){RateCard rate=rates.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(session.getGarage().getId(),session.getSpot().getType()).orElse(null);BigDecimal first=rate==null?session.getGarage().getFirstHourRate():rate.getFirstHourRate();BigDecimal extra=rate==null?session.getGarage().getExtraHourRate():rate.getExtraHourRate();BigDecimal cap=rate==null?session.getGarage().getDailyCap():rate.getDailyCap();FeeCalculator.Breakdown fee=FeeCalculator.calculate(Duration.between(session.getCheckedInAt(),now).toMinutes(),first,extra,cap);session.setCheckedOutAt(now);session.setHoursBilled(fee.hoursBilled());session.setFee(fee.totalFee());session.setClosedBy(ParkingSession.ClosedBy.AUTO);session.setActiveSpotId(null);session.setActivePlateKey(null);sessions.save(session);Map<String,Object> row=new LinkedHashMap<>();row.put(\"sessionId\",session.getId());row.put(\"plate\",session.getPlate());row.put(\"spot\",session.getSpot().getCode());row.put(\"checkedInAt\",session.getCheckedInAt());row.put(\"checkedOutAt\",now);row.put(\"hoursBilled\",fee.hoursBilled());row.put(\"fee\",fee.totalFee());closed.add(row);}return closed;}\n}",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 1,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }

                "text": "package com.parksmart.controller;\n\nimport java.time.*; import java.util.*; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import com.parksmart.service.*;\n\n@RestController public class ClockController {\n    private final ClockService clock; private final AutoCloseService autoClose;\n    public ClockController(ClockService c,AutoCloseService a){clock=c;autoClose=a;}\n    @GetMapping(\"/clock\") public Map<String,Object> get(){return Map.of(\"now\",clock.now(),\"simulated\",clock.isSimulated());}\n    @PostMapping(\"/clock\") public Map<String,Object> set(@RequestBody(required=false) Map<String,Object> body){Instant now;if(body!=null&&body.get(\"now\")!=null)now=clock.setNow(Instant.parse(body.get(\"now\").toString()));else if(body!=null&&body.get(\"advanceHours\")!=null)now=clock.advance(Duration.ofHours(((Number)body.get(\"advanceHours\")).longValue()));else if(body!=null&&body.get(\"advanceMinutes\")!=null)now=clock.advance(Duration.ofMinutes(((Number)body.get(\"advanceMinutes\")).longValue()));else now=clock.now();return Map.of(\"now\",now,\"autoClosed\",autoClose.runAutoClose(now));}\n    @PostMapping(\"/clock/reset\") public Map<String,Object> reset(){return Map.of(\"now\",clock.reset());}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.config;\nimport org.springframework.context.annotation.*; import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity; import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy; import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder; import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder; import org.springframework.security.web.*; import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;\n@Configuration public class SecurityConfig { @Bean PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder(){return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();} @Bean SecurityFilterChain security(HttpSecurity http,JwtFilter filter)throws Exception{return http.csrf(c->c.disable()).cors(c->c.disable()).sessionManagement(s->s.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS)).authorizeHttpRequests(a->a.requestMatchers(\"/\",\"/*.html\",\"/css/**\",\"/js/**\",\"/api/auth/**\",\"/clock\",\"/clock/reset\").permitAll().anyRequest().authenticated()).addFilterBefore(filter,UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class).build();} }",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal; import java.time.*; import java.util.*; import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.repository.*;\n\n@Service public class AutoCloseService {\n    private final ParkingSessionRepository sessions; private final RateCardRepository rates; private final ClockService clock;\n    public AutoCloseService(ParkingSessionRepository s,RateCardRepository r,ClockService c){sessions=s;rates=r;clock=c;}\n    @Scheduled(cron=\"0 0 0 * * *\") public void nightly(){runAutoClose(clock.now());}\n    @Transactional public List<Map<String,Object>> runAutoClose(Instant now){List<Map<String,Object>> closed=new ArrayList<>();for(ParkingSession session:sessions.findByCheckedOutAtIsNullAndCheckedInAtBefore(now.minus(24,java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.HOURS))){RateCard rate=rates.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(session.getGarage().getId(),session.getSpot().getType()).orElse(null);BigDecimal first=rate==null?session.getGarage().getFirstHourRate():rate.getFirstHourRate();BigDecimal extra=rate==null?session.getGarage().getExtraHourRate():rate.getExtraHourRate();BigDecimal cap=rate==null?session.getGarage().getDailyCap():rate.getDailyCap();FeeCalculator.Breakdown fee=FeeCalculator.calculate(Duration.between(session.getCheckedInAt(),now).toMinutes(),first,extra,cap);session.setCheckedOutAt(now);session.setHoursBilled(fee.hoursBilled());session.setFee(fee.totalFee());session.setClosedBy(ParkingSession.ClosedBy.AUTO);session.setActiveSpotId(null);session.setActivePlateKey(null);sessions.save(session);Map<String,Object> row=new LinkedHashMap<>();row.put(\"sessionId\",session.getId());row.put(\"plate\",session.getPlate());row.put(\"spot\",session.getSpot().getCode());row.put(\"checkedInAt\",session.getCheckedInAt());row.put(\"checkedOutAt\",now);row.put(\"hoursBilled\",fee.hoursBilled());row.put(\"fee\",fee.totalFee());closed.add(row);}return closed;}\n}",

                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 11,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }

                "text": "package com.parksmart.entity;\nimport java.time.Instant; import jakarta.persistence.*;\n@Entity @Table(name=\"session_transfer\") public class SessionTransfer {\n @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id; @ManyToOne(optional=false,fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private ParkingSession session; @Column(nullable=false) private String fromPlate; @Column(nullable=false) private String toPlate; private String reason; @Column(nullable=false) private Instant transferredAt; @ManyToOne(fetch=FetchType.LAZY) private User attendant;\n public SessionTransfer(){} public SessionTransfer(ParkingSession s,String from,String to,String reason,Instant at,User user){session=s;fromPlate=from;toPlate=to;this.reason=reason;transferredAt=at;attendant=user;} public Long getId(){return id;} public ParkingSession getSession(){return session;} public String getFromPlate(){return fromPlate;} public String getToPlate(){return toPlate;} public String getReason(){return reason;} public Instant getTransferredAt(){return transferredAt;} public User getAttendant(){return attendant;}\n}",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.service;\nimport java.time.*; import java.util.*; import java.util.stream.*; import java.math.BigDecimal; import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification; import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus; import org.springframework.stereotype.Service; import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.exception.ApiException; import com.parksmart.repository.*;\n@Service public class ParkingService {\n private final GarageRepository garages; private final SpotRepository spots; private final ParkingSessionRepository sessions; private final UserRepository users; private final ClockService clock; private final RateCardRepository rateCards; private final SessionTransferRepository transfers;\n public ParkingService(GarageRepository g,SpotRepository s,ParkingSessionRepository p,UserRepository u,ClockService c,RateCardRepository rates,SessionTransferRepository t){garages=g;spots=s;sessions=p;users=u;clock=c;rateCards=rates;transfers=t;}\n public Garage garage(long id){return garages.findById(id).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"GARAGE_NOT_FOUND\",\"Garage not found\"));}\n public List<Garage> garages(){return garages.findAll();} public Garage saveGarage(Garage g){return garages.save(g);}\n public List<Spot> spots(long id){garage(id);return spots.findByGarageId(id);} public List<Spot> addSpots(long id,Requests.SpotsRequest r){Garage g=garage(id);return spots.saveAll(r.spots.stream().map(x->new Spot(g,x.level,x.code,x.type)).toList());}\n private String plate(String p){return p.replaceAll(\"[\\\\s-]\",\"\").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);} private SpotType required(VehicleType v){return v==VehicleType.EV?SpotType.EV:v==VehicleType.COMPACT?SpotType.COMPACT:SpotType.STANDARD;}\n private Spot choose(long gid,VehicleType type,Long requested){if(requested!=null){Spot s=spots.findById(requested).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"SPOT_NOT_FOUND\",\"Spot not found\"));if(!s.getGarage().getId().equals(gid)||sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())||(type==VehicleType.EV?s.getType()!=SpotType.EV:type==VehicleType.STANDARD?s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD:(s.getType()!=SpotType.COMPACT&&s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD)))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"SPOT_UNAVAILABLE\",\"Requested spot is unavailable or incompatible\");return s;}List<Spot> free=spots.findFree(gid,required(type));if(type==VehicleType.COMPACT&&free.isEmpty())free=spots.findFree(gid,SpotType.STANDARD);if(free.isEmpty())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"NO_SPOT\",\"No compatible spot is available\");return free.get(0);}\n @Transactional public ParkingSession checkIn(long gid,Requests.CheckInRequest r,String email){String plate=plate(r.plate);if(sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"PLATE_ACTIVE\",\"Plate already has an active session\");Spot spot=choose(gid,r.vehicleType,r.spotId);ParkingSession p=new ParkingSession();p.setGarage(garage(gid));p.setSpot(spot);p.setPlate(plate);p.setVehicleType(r.vehicleType);p.setCheckedInAt(clock.now());p.setActiveSpotId(spot.getId());p.setActivePlateKey(gid+\":\"+plate);p.setAttendant(users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElse(null));try{return sessions.saveAndFlush(p);}catch(DataIntegrityViolationException e){throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"CONFLICT\",\"Spot or plate is already active\");}}\n private FeeCalculator.Breakdown fee(ParkingSession p,Instant now){RateCard rate=rateCards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(p.getGarage().getId(),p.getSpot().getType()).orElse(null);return FeeCalculator.calculate(Duration.between(p.getCheckedInAt(),now).toMinutes(),rate==null?p.getGarage().getFirstHourRate():rate.getFirstHourRate(),rate==null?p.getGarage().getExtraHourRate():rate.getExtraHourRate(),rate==null?p.getGarage().getDailyCap():rate.getDailyCap());}\n @Transactional public Map<String,Object> checkOut(long gid,String raw,String email){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);Instant now=clock.now();FeeCalculator.Breakdown b=fee(p,now);p.setCheckedOutAt(now);p.setHoursBilled(b.hoursBilled());p.setFee(b.totalFee());p.setClosedBy(ParkingSession.ClosedBy.ATTENDANT);p.setActivePlateKey(null);p.setActiveSpotId(null);sessions.save(p);return result(p,b);}\n public Map<String,Object> quote(long gid,String raw){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);return result(p,fee(p,clock.now()));} private Map<String,Object> result(ParkingSession p,FeeCalculator.Breakdown b){return Map.of(\"id\",p.getId(),\"plate\",p.getPlate(),\"durationMinutes\",b.durationMinutes(),\"hoursBilled\",b.hoursBilled(),\"fullDays\",b.fullDays(),\"remainderHours\",b.remainingHours(),\"remainderFee\",b.remainderFee(),\"fee\",b.totalFee());}\n public ParkingSession active(long gid,String raw){return sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate(raw)).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"ACTIVE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND\",\"No active session for plate\"));}\n @Transactional public SessionTransfer transfer(long gid,String fromRaw,String toRaw,String reason,String email){String from=plate(fromRaw),to=plate(toRaw);if(from.equals(to))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,\"SAME_PLATE\",\"Source and destination plates must differ\");ParkingSession session=active(gid,from);if(sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+to).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"PLATE_ACTIVE\",\"Destination plate already has an active session\");session.setPlate(to);session.setActivePlateKey(gid+\":\"+to);sessions.saveAndFlush(session);return transfers.save(new SessionTransfer(session,from,to,reason,clock.now(),users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElse(null)));}\n public List<SessionTransfer> transfers(long sessionId){return transfers.findBySessionIdOrderByTransferredAtAsc(sessionId);}\n public Map<String,Object> availability(long gid,SpotType filter){garage(gid);List<Spot> all=spots.findByGarageId(gid);Map<String,Object> out=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(SpotType t:SpotType.values())if(filter==null||t==filter){List<Spot> list=all.stream().filter(s->s.getType()==t&&!sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())).toList();out.put(t.name(),Map.of(\"free\",list.size(),\"byLevel\",list.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Spot::getLevel,Collectors.counting())),\"spots\",list.stream().map(Spot::getCode).toList()));}return out;}\n public Page<ParkingSession> search(long gid,String q,String status,Instant from,Instant to,Pageable page){Specification<ParkingSession> s=(root,x,cb)->cb.equal(root.get(\"garage\").get(\"id\"),gid);if(q!=null&&!q.isBlank())s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.like(r.get(\"plate\"),\"%\"+plate(q)+\"%\"));if(\"ACTIVE\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(\"COMPLETED\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNotNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(from!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.greaterThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),from));if(to!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.lessThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),to));return sessions.findAll(s,page);}\n}",

com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault; import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.service.*;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; private final ClockService clock; private final RateCardService rates; private final ObjectMapper mapper; public GarageController(ParkingService s,ClockService c,RateCardService r,ObjectMapper m){service=s;clock=c;rates=r;mapper=m;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap);g.setCreatedAt(clock.now());return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/rates\") public Object rates(@PathVariable long id){return rates.find(id);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"text/plain\") public Object importText(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody String text){return rates.importText(id,text);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"application/json\") public Object importJson(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody JsonNode body){return rates.importRows(id,body);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.SpotsRequest r){return service.addSpots(id,r);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/availability\") public Object availability(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) SpotType type){return service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){ParkingSession s=service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());return session(s);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/transfer\") public Object transfer(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){SessionTransfer transfer=service.transfer(id,body.getOrDefault(\"fromPlate\",\"\"),body.getOrDefault(\"toPlate\",\"\"),body.get(\"reason\"),a.getName());return transfer(transfer);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}/transfers\") public Object transfers(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable long sessionId){service.garage(id);return service.transfers(sessionId).stream().map(this::transfer).toList();}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Map.of(\"content\",p.getContent().stream().map(this::session).toList(),\"page\",p.getNumber(),\"size\",p.getSize(),\"totalElements\",p.getTotalElements(),\"totalPages\",p.getTotalPages());}\n private Map<String,Object> session(ParkingSession s){Map<String,Object> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();result.put(\"id\",s.getId());result.put(\"plate\",s.getPlate());result.put(\"vehicleType\",s.getVehicleType());result.put(\"spot\",Map.of(\"id\",s.getSpot().getId(),\"code\",s.getSpot().getCode(),\"level\",s.getSpot().getLevel(),\"type\",s.getSpot().getType()));result.put(\"checkedInAt\",s.getCheckedInAt());result.put(\"checkedOutAt\",s.getCheckedOutAt());result.put(\"hoursBilled\",s.getHoursBilled()==null?0:s.getHoursBilled());result.put(\"fee\",s.getFee()==null?0:s.getFee());return result;}\n private Map<String,Object> transfer(SessionTransfer t){Map<String,Object> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();result.put(\"id\",t.getId());result.put(\"sessionId\",t.getSession().getId());result.put(\"fromPlate\",t.getFromPlate());result.put(\"toPlate\",t.getToPlate());result.put(\"reason\",t.getReason());result.put(\"transferredAt\",t.getTransferredAt());return result;}\n}",

              {
                "text": "async function loadRates(){const rows=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/rates`);$('rates').innerHTML=rows.map(r=>`<tr><td>${r.spotType}</td><td>${money(r.firstHourRate)}</td><td>${money(r.extraHourRate)}</td><td>${money(r.dailyCap)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan=\"4\">Garage defaults in use.</td></tr>'}\nasync function loadClock(){const value=await api('/clock',{},false);$('clockNow').textContent=new Date(value.now).toLocaleString()}\n$('rateForm').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const r=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/rates/import`,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain'},body:$('rateText').value});$('rateResult').textContent=`Imported ${r.imported.length} rate card(s); rejected ${r.rejected.length}.`;loadRates()}catch(x){$('rateResult').textContent=x.message}}\n$('transferForm').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const body=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target));const r=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/sessions/transfer`,{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(body)});$('transferResult').textContent=`${r.fromPlate} is now ${r.toPlate}.`;e.target.reset();loadSessions()}catch(x){$('transferResult').textContent=x.message}}\ndocument.querySelectorAll('[data-advance]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=async()=>{try{const r=await api('/clock',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({advanceHours:Number(button.dataset.advance)})},false);$('clockNow').textContent=new Date(r.now).toLocaleString();$('autoClosed').textContent=r.autoClosed.length?`${r.autoClosed.length} session(s) auto-closed.`:'No sessions auto-closed.';loadSessions()}catch(x){$('autoClosed').textContent=x.message}});$('clockReset').onclick=async()=>{const r=await api('/clock/reset',{method:'POST'},false);$('clockNow').textContent=new Date(r.now).toLocaleString();$('autoClosed').textContent='Clock reset.'}\nsetTimeout(()=>{if(typeof garageId!=='undefined'){loadRates();loadClock()}},500)\n",

          "edits": [

              {
                "text": "# ParkSmart\n\nConfigurable parking garage attendant system built with Spring Boot 3.5, SQLite, and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript.\n\n## Run in Codespaces\n\nRequires JDK 21+ (JDK 25 works) and Maven 3.9+.\n\n```bash\nmvn test\nmvn spring-boot:run\n```\n\nOpen `http://localhost:8080`. The first run seeds City Centre Garage and `admin@parksmart.com` / `admin123`. Reset with `rm -f parksmart.db`.\n\n## API\n\nExcept `/api/auth/**` and static pages, endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| POST | `/api/auth/register` | Create account |\n| POST | `/api/auth/login` | Return JWT |\n| GET | `/api/auth/me` | Current user |\n| GET/POST | `/api/garages` | List/create garages |\n| GET/PUT | `/api/garages/{id}` | Read/update rates |\n| GET/POST | `/api/garages/{id}/spots` | List/bulk-create spots |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/availability?type=EV` | Free counts and spots |\n| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkin` | Start session |\n| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/checkout` | Charge and close session |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/quote?plate=ABC123` | Current fee quote |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}` | Active vehicle |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions` | Filtered pageable log |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/rates` | Cleaned rate cards |\n| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/rates/import` | Import CSV or JSON rate cards |\n| POST/GET | `/clock` | Set/advance or read simulated time |\n| POST | `/clock/reset` | Return to system time |\n| POST | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions/transfer` | Transfer an active valet session |\n| GET | `/api/garages/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}/transfers` | Transfer audit history |\n\nExample:\n\n```bash\nTOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"email\":\"admin@parksmart.com\",\"password\":\"admin123\"}' | jq -r .token)\ncurl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" localhost:8080/api/garages\ncurl -X POST localhost:8080/api/garages/1/checkin -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"plate\":\"ab-123\",\"vehicleType\":\"COMPACT\"}'\ncurl -X POST localhost:8080/api/garages/1/rates/import -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' --data-binary $'type,first,extra,cap\\nEV,100,40,500\\ncompact,$50,$20,$300'\ncurl -X POST localhost:8080/clock -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"advanceHours\":25}'\ncurl -X POST localhost:8080/api/garages/1/sessions/transfer -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"fromPlate\":\"AB123\",\"toPlate\":\"ZX999\",\"reason\":\"Valet hand-off\"}'\n```\n\n## MySQL and debugging\n\nUncomment the MySQL properties in `application.properties`, add the MySQL JDBC driver, and set credentials. Tests use `parksmart-test.db`, a separate SQLite file. Check the Spring Boot console and run `mvn test` when debugging.\n",

              {
                "text": "# ParkSmart reasoning\n\n## Fee model\n\nMinutes round up to hours, minimum one hour. Complete 24-hour blocks cost `dailyCap`; a remainder costs `min(dailyCap, firstHourRate + (remainingHours - 1) * extraHourRate)`. Thus 61 minutes is two hours, 24 hours is one cap, 25 hours is one cap plus one hour.\n\n`FeeCalculator` is pure and tested for 1, 59, 60, 61, 5, cap-hit, 24, 25, and 50 hours.\n\n## Design decisions\n\nGarage rates and spots are data, not constants. EV vehicles use only EV spots; standard vehicles use standard spots; compact vehicles prefer compact and fall back to standard. Plates are uppercase with spaces and dashes removed.\n\nActive sessions store nullable unique `active_spot_id` and `active_plate_key` (`garageId:plate`). They are set on check-in and cleared on checkout. The transactional service checks first for clear errors, while database uniqueness and `DataIntegrityViolationException` protect concurrent requests.\n\n## Testing and fixes\n\n`mvn test` runs the fee suite and a Spring context smoke test against separate SQLite. Manual checks use the seeded login, protected garage request, availability, check-in, quote, and checkout curl calls. Boundary tests caught incorrect expectations for 24 and 50 hours; expected values were corrected to match the formula.\n\n## Twist decisions\n\n**T4 rate cards:** `RateCardParser` treats the first non-comment row as a case-insensitive, trimmed header, accepts the documented aliases, normalizes messy vehicle-type names and money tokens, skips repeated headers, rejects invalid business values with line/raw/reason, and lets the last valid duplicate win. Checkout resolves the card using the actual spot type and falls back to garage defaults.\n\n**T2 clock and automation:** `ClockService` wraps `java.time.Clock`; all application-controlled timestamps use it, with system UTC as the default and a fixed clock for simulation. Auto-close selects only active sessions older than 24 hours, clears active uniqueness fields, records `AUTO`, and is idempotent because a closed row no longer matches the query. The root clock endpoint runs the same service used by the midnight scheduler.\n\n**T6 transfers:** A hand-off changes the plate and active key on the existing session row, preserving spot, vehicle type, and original entry time. It rejects equal plates, missing source sessions, and active destinations, and records an audit row with attendant, reason, and the controlled transfer time. Checkout by the new plate therefore charges from the original arrival.\n\nTests cover parser cleaning/rejection/override behavior, clock set/advance/reset, existing fee boundaries, application startup, and the transactional workflow slices. A notable bug fixed during the extension was null JSON serialization for active sessions; response maps now deliberately preserve `checkedOutAt: null` and expose `closedBy`.",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 28,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }
            ],

                "text": "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,initial-scale=1\"><title>ParkSmart | Calm parking operations</title><link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/css/style.css\"></head>\n<body class=\"landing\"><nav><a class=\"brand\" href=\"/\">Park<span>Smart</span></a><div><a class=\"navlink\" href=\"/login.html\">Log in</a><a class=\"button small\" href=\"/register.html\">Create account</a></div></nav>\n<main><section class=\"hero\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">CITY PARKING, MADE CLEAR</p><h1>Every arrival has a place.</h1><p class=\"lede\">ParkSmart gives attendants one reliable view of capacity, check-ins, check-outs, rate-card imports, and the fee due.</p><a class=\"button\" href=\"/login.html\">Open the attendant desk <span>→</span></a></section>\n<section class=\"feature-grid\"><article><b>01 / LIVE CAPACITY</b><h2>Know what is free before the next car turns in.</h2><p>Garage-level and floor-level availability, including EV spots, at a glance.</p></article><article><b>02 / FAIR FEES</b><h2>Charge by the rules, every time.</h2><p>Messy rate-card imports become clean per-type pricing with daily caps.</p></article><article><b>03 / LIFECYCLE CONTROL</b><h2>Hand off, auto-close, and keep moving.</h2><p>Valet transfer history and nightly auto-close prevent stale sessions from blocking capacity.</p></article></section>\n<section class=\"audience\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">BUILT FOR</p><h2>Attendants who need the next answer quickly.</h2></div><p>ParkSmart keeps the operational screen focused: find a car, place a car, settle a car. It works for any garage with its own levels, spots, pricing, and rate-card import.</p></section>\n<section class=\"coming\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">COMING NEXT</p><div><span>Plate-recognition camera</span><span>Online pre-booking</span><span>EV charging billing</span></div></section></main></body></html>\n",

                "text": "package com.parksmart.controller;\nimport java.time.Instant; import java.util.Map; import java.util.List; import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode; import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; import org.springframework.data.domain.*; import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault; import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat; import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication; import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*; import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile; import jakarta.validation.Valid; import com.parksmart.dto.Requests; import com.parksmart.entity.*; import com.parksmart.service.*;\n@RestController @RequestMapping(\"/api/garages\") public class GarageController { private final ParkingService service; private final ClockService clock; private final RateCardService rates; private final ObjectMapper mapper; public GarageController(ParkingService s,ClockService c,RateCardService r,ObjectMapper m){service=s;clock=c;rates=r;mapper=m;}\n @GetMapping public Object all(){return service.garages();}\n @PostMapping public Garage create(@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=new Garage(r.name,r.address,r.firstHourRate,r.extraHourRate,r.dailyCap);g.setCreatedAt(clock.now());return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage one(@PathVariable long id){return service.garage(id);}\n @PutMapping(\"/{id}\") public Garage update(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.GarageRequest r){Garage g=service.garage(id);g.setName(r.name);g.setAddress(r.address);g.setFirstHourRate(r.firstHourRate);g.setExtraHourRate(r.extraHourRate);g.setDailyCap(r.dailyCap);return service.saveGarage(g);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/rates\") public Object rates(@PathVariable long id){return rates.find(id);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"text/plain\") public Object importText(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody String text){return rates.importText(id,text);}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"multipart/form-data\") public Object importFile(@PathVariable long id,@RequestPart(\"file\") MultipartFile file)throws java.io.IOException{return rates.importText(id,new String(file.getBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}\n @PostMapping(value=\"/{id}/rates/import\",consumes=\"application/json\") public Object importJson(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody JsonNode body){return rates.importRows(id,body);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object spots(@PathVariable long id){return service.spots(id);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/spots\") public Object addSpots(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.SpotsRequest r){return service.addSpots(id,r);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/availability\") public Object availability(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) SpotType type){return service.availability(id,type);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkin\") public Object checkin(@PathVariable long id,@Valid @RequestBody Requests.CheckInRequest r,Authentication a){ParkingSession s=service.checkIn(id,r,a.getName());return session(s);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/checkout\") public Object checkout(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){return service.checkOut(id,body.getOrDefault(\"plate\",\"\"),a.getName());}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/quote\") public Object quote(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam String plate){return service.quote(id,plate);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/active/{plate}\") public Object active(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable String plate){return service.active(id,plate);}\n @PostMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/transfer\") public Object transfer(@PathVariable long id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body,Authentication a){SessionTransfer transfer=service.transfer(id,body.getOrDefault(\"fromPlate\",\"\"),body.getOrDefault(\"toPlate\",\"\"),body.get(\"reason\"),a.getName());return transfer(transfer);}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}/transfers\") public Object transfers(@PathVariable long id,@PathVariable long sessionId){service.garage(id);return service.transfers(sessionId).stream().map(this::transfer).toList();}\n @GetMapping(\"/{id}/sessions\") public Object sessions(@PathVariable long id,@RequestParam(required=false) String q,@RequestParam(required=false) String status,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant from,@RequestParam(required=false) @DateTimeFormat(iso=DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) Instant to,@PageableDefault(size=20,sort=\"checkedInAt\",direction=Sort.Direction.DESC) Pageable page){Page<ParkingSession> p=service.search(id,q,status,from,to,page);return Map.of(\"content\",p.getContent().stream().map(this::session).toList(),\"page\",p.getNumber(),\"size\",p.getSize(),\"totalElements\",p.getTotalElements(),\"totalPages\",p.getTotalPages());}\n private Map<String,Object> session(ParkingSession s){Map<String,Object> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();result.put(\"id\",s.getId());result.put(\"plate\",s.getPlate());result.put(\"vehicleType\",s.getVehicleType());result.put(\"spot\",Map.of(\"id\",s.getSpot().getId(),\"code\",s.getSpot().getCode(),\"level\",s.getSpot().getLevel(),\"type\",s.getSpot().getType()));result.put(\"checkedInAt\",s.getCheckedInAt());result.put(\"checkedOutAt\",s.getCheckedOutAt());result.put(\"hoursBilled\",s.getHoursBilled()==null?0:s.getHoursBilled());result.put(\"fee\",s.getFee()==null?0:s.getFee());return result;}\n private Map<String,Object> transfer(SessionTransfer t){Map<String,Object> result=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();result.put(\"id\",t.getId());result.put(\"sessionId\",t.getSession().getId());result.put(\"fromPlate\",t.getFromPlate());result.put(\"toPlate\",t.getToPlate());result.put(\"reason\",t.getReason());result.put(\"transferredAt\",t.getTransferredAt());return result;}\n}",

                                  "text": " public List<Spot> spots(long id){garage(id);return spots.findByGarageId(id);} public List<Spot> addSpots(long id,Requests.SpotsRequest r){Garage g=garage(id);return spots.saveAll(r.spots.stream().map(x->new Spot(g,x.level,x.code,x.type)).toList());}\n",

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 10,
                                  "text": " private String plate(String p){return p.replaceAll(\"[\\\\s-]\",\"\").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);} private SpotType required(VehicleType v){return v==VehicleType.EV?SpotType.EV:v==VehicleType.COMPACT?SpotType.COMPACT:SpotType.STANDARD;}\n",

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 9,
                                  "text": " private Spot choose(long gid,VehicleType type,Long requested){if(requested!=null){Spot s=spots.findById(requested).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"SPOT_NOT_FOUND\",\"Spot not found\"));if(!s.getGarage().getId().equals(gid)||sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())||(type==VehicleType.EV?s.getType()!=SpotType.EV:type==VehicleType.STANDARD?s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD:(s.getType()!=SpotType.COMPACT&&s.getType()!=SpotType.STANDARD)))throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"SPOT_UNAVAILABLE\",\"Requested spot is unavailable or incompatible\");return s;}List<Spot> free=spots.findFree(gid,required(type));if(type==VehicleType.COMPACT&&free.isEmpty())free=spots.findFree(gid,SpotType.STANDARD);if(free.isEmpty())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"NO_SPOT\",\"No compatible spot is available\");return free.get(0);}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 9
                              },
                              "references": []

                              "type": 1,

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 8,
                                  "text": " @Transactional public ParkingSession checkIn(long gid,Requests.CheckInRequest r,String email){String plate=plate(r.plate);if(sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate).isPresent())throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"PLATE_ACTIVE\",\"Plate already has an active session\");Spot spot=choose(gid,r.vehicleType,r.spotId);ParkingSession p=new ParkingSession();p.setGarage(garage(gid));p.setSpot(spot);p.setPlate(plate);p.setVehicleType(r.vehicleType);p.setCheckedInAt(Instant.now());p.setActiveSpotId(spot.getId());p.setActivePlateKey(gid+\":\"+plate);p.setAttendant(users.findByEmailIgnoreCase(email).orElse(null));try{return sessions.saveAndFlush(p);}catch(DataIntegrityViolationException e){throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,\"CONFLICT\",\"Spot or plate is already active\");}}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 8

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 7,
                                  "text": " private FeeCalculator.Breakdown fee(ParkingSession p,Instant now){return FeeCalculator.calculate(Duration.between(p.getCheckedInAt(),now).toMinutes(),p.getGarage().getFirstHourRate(),p.getGarage().getExtraHourRate(),p.getGarage().getDailyCap());}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 7
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 6,
                                  "text": " @Transactional public Map<String,Object> checkOut(long gid,String raw,String email){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);FeeCalculator.Breakdown b=fee(p,Instant.now());p.setCheckedOutAt(Instant.now());p.setHoursBilled(b.hoursBilled());p.setFee(b.totalFee());p.setActivePlateKey(null);p.setActiveSpotId(null);sessions.save(p);return result(p,b);}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 6
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 5,
                                  "text": " public Map<String,Object> quote(long gid,String raw){ParkingSession p=active(gid,raw);return result(p,fee(p,Instant.now()));} private Map<String,Object> result(ParkingSession p,FeeCalculator.Breakdown b){return Map.of(\"id\",p.getId(),\"plate\",p.getPlate(),\"durationMinutes\",b.durationMinutes(),\"hoursBilled\",b.hoursBilled(),\"fullDays\",b.fullDays(),\"remainderHours\",b.remainingHours(),\"remainderFee\",b.remainderFee(),\"fee\",b.totalFee());}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 5
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                              "type": 1,

                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 4,
                                  "text": " public ParkingSession active(long gid,String raw){return sessions.findByGarageIdAndActivePlateKey(gid,gid+\":\"+plate(raw)).orElseThrow(()->new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\"ACTIVE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND\",\"No active session for plate\"));}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 4
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 3,
                                  "text": " public Map<String,Object> availability(long gid,SpotType filter){garage(gid);List<Spot> all=spots.findByGarageId(gid);Map<String,Object> out=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(SpotType t:SpotType.values())if(filter==null||t==filter){List<Spot> list=all.stream().filter(s->s.getType()==t&&!sessions.existsByGarageIdAndActiveSpotId(gid,s.getId())).toList();out.put(t.name(),Map.of(\"free\",list.size(),\"byLevel\",list.stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Spot::getLevel,Collectors.counting())),\"spots\",list.stream().map(Spot::getCode).toList()));}return out;}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 3
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 2,
                                  "text": " public Page<ParkingSession> search(long gid,String q,String status,Instant from,Instant to,Pageable page){Specification<ParkingSession> s=(root,x,cb)->cb.equal(root.get(\"garage\").get(\"id\"),gid);if(q!=null&&!q.isBlank())s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.like(r.get(\"plate\"),\"%\"+plate(q)+\"%\"));if(\"ACTIVE\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(\"COMPLETED\".equals(status))s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.isNotNull(r.get(\"checkedOutAt\")));if(from!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.greaterThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),from));if(to!=null)s=s.and((r,x,c)->c.lessThanOrEqualTo(r.get(\"checkedInAt\"),to));return sessions.findAll(s,page);}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
