Promise.all([api('/api/auth/me'),api('/api/garages')]);$('name').textContent=me.name.split(' ')[0];$('user').textContent=me.email;garages.forEach(g=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=g.id;o.textContent=g.name;$('garage').append(o)});garageId=garages[0]?.id;await refresh()}catch(e){console.error(e)}}async function refresh(){if(!garageId)return;const a=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/availability`);const types=['COMPACT','STANDARD','EV'];$('stats').innerHTML=types.map(t=>`<div class=\"stat\"><strong>${a[t]?.free||0}</strong><span>${t} spots free</span></div>`).join('')+`<div class=\"stat ${a.EV?.free?'yes':'no'}\"><strong>${a.EV?.free?'YES':'NO'}</strong><span>EV spot free now?</span></div>`;const spots=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/spots`);$('checkin').spotId.innerHTML='<option value=\"\">Assign automatically</option>'+spots.map(s=>`<option value=\"${s.id}\">${s.code} · ${s.type} · L${s.level}</option>`).join('');loadSessions()}async function loadSessions(){const q=encodeURIComponent($('search').value);const status=$('status').value;const p=await api(`/api/garages/${garageId}/sessions?q=${q}&status=${status}&page=${pageNumber}&size=20&sort=checkedInAt,desc`);$('sessions').innerHTML=p.content.map(s=>`<tr><td><b>${s.plate}</b></td><td>${s.vehicleType}</td><td>${s.spot?.code||'—'}</td><td>${new Date(s.checkedInAt).toLocaleString()}</td><td><span class=\"badge ${s.checkedOutAt?'completed':''}\">${s.checkedOutAt?'COMPLETED':'ACTIVE'}</span></td><td>${s.fee?money(s.fee):'—'}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan=\"6\">No sessions found.</td></tr>';$('page').textContent=`Page ${p.page+1}`;$('prev').disabled=p.page===0;$('next').disabled=p.page+1>=p.totalPages}$('garage').onchange=async e=>{garageId=e.target.value;pageNumber=0;refresh()};$('refresh').on [truncated]\n",

                                  "type": 2,

                                  "text": "@Configuration public class DataSeeder { @Bean CommandLineRunner seed(GarageRepository garages,SpotRepository spots,UserRepository users,PasswordEncoder encoder){return args->{if(garages.count()>0)return;Garage g=garages.save(new Garage(\"City Centre Garage\",\"1 Market Street\",new BigDecimal(\"50\"),new BigDecimal(\"30\"),new BigDecimal(\"300\")));List<Spot> values=new ArrayList<>();for(int level=1;level<=3;level++){values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"C\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.COMPACT));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"S\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.STANDARD));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"E\"+level+\"01\",SpotType.EV));values.add(new Spot(g,level,\"S\"+level+\"02\",SpotType.STANDARD));}spots.saveAll(values);users.save(new User(\"Administrator\",\"admin@parksmart.com\",encoder.encode(\"admin123\")));};}}",

                                  "priority": 8,
                                  "text": "@Service public class RateCardService {\n",

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 7,
                                  "text": "    private final RateCardRepository cards; private final ParkingService parking; private final ClockService clock;\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 7

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 6,
                                  "text": "    public RateCardService(RateCardRepository c,ParkingService p,ClockService clock){cards=c;parking=p;this.clock=clock;}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 6
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 5,
                                  "text": "    public List<RateCard> find(long garageId){parking.garage(garageId);return cards.findByGarageId(garageId);}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 5
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 4,
                                  "text": "    @Transactional public RateCardParser.Result importText(long garageId,String text){Garage garage=parking.garage(garageId);RateCardParser.Result result=RateCardParser.parse(text);for(RateCardParser.Row row:result.imported()){RateCard card=cards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(garageId,row.spotType()).orElseGet(RateCard::new);card.setGarage(garage);card.setSpotType(row.spotType());card.setFirstHourRate(row.firstHourRate());card.setExtraHourRate(row.extraHourRate());card.setDailyCap(row.dailyCap());card.setUpdatedAt(clock.now());cards.save(card);}return result;}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 4
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 3,
                                  "text": "    public RateCardParser.Result importRows(long garageId,JsonNode body){StringBuilder csv=new StringBuilder(\"type,first,extra,cap\\n\");for(JsonNode row:body)csv.append(row.path(\"type\").asText(row.path(\"spotType\").asText())).append(',').append(row.path(\"first\").asText(row.path(\"firstHourRate\").asText())).append(',').append(row.path(\"extra\").asText(row.path(\"extraHourRate\").asText())).append(',').append(row.path(\"cap\").asText(row.path(\"dailyCap\").asText())).append('\\n');return importText(garageId,csv.toString());}\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 3
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 2,
                                  "text": "    public RateCard rateFor(Spot spot){return cards.findByGarageIdAndSpotType(spot.getGarage().getId(),spot.getType()).orElse(null);}\n",

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 13,
                                  "text": "Minutes round up to hours, minimum one hour. Complete 24-hour blocks cost `dailyCap`; a remainder costs `min(dailyCap, firstHourRate + (remainingHours - 1) * extraHourRate)`. Thus 61 minutes is two hours, 24 hours is one cap, 25 hours is one cap plus one hour.\n",

                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {

                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 12,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 12
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 11,
                                  "text": "`FeeCalculator` is pure and tested for 1, 59, 60, 61, 5, cap-hit, 24, 25, and 50 hours.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 11
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 10,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 10
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 9,
                                  "text": "## Design decisions\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 9
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 8,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 8
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 7,
                                  "text": "Garage rates and spots are data, not constants. EV vehicles use only EV spots; standard vehicles use standard spots; compact vehicles prefer compact and fall back to standard. Plates are uppercase with spaces and dashes removed.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 7
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 6,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 6
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 5,
                                  "text": "Active sessions store nullable unique `active_spot_id` and `active_plate_key` (`garageId:plate`). They are set on check-in and cleared on checkout. The transactional service checks first for clear errors, while database uniqueness and `DataIntegrityViolationException` protect concurrent requests.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 5
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 4,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 4
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 3,
                                  "text": "## Testing and fixes\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 3
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 2,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 2
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "s$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 17,
                                  "text": "`mvn test` runs the fee suite and a Spring context smoke test against separate SQLite. Manual checks use the seeded login, protected garage request, availability, check-in, quote, and checkout curl calls. Boundary tests caught incorrect expectations for 24 and 50 hours; expected values were corrected to match the formula.",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 17
                              },
                              "references": []
                            }
                          ],
                          "props": {},
                          "references": []
                        }
                      ],
                      "props": {},
                      "references": []
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
